people.tiZh: 沃顿商学院教授
people.bioEn: Wharton professor studying AI and work. His One Useful Thing essays, like Centaurs and Cyborgs, supplied the shared vocabulary for human-AI collaboration.
people.bioZh: 沃顿商学院教授，研究 AI 与工作。One Useful Thing 系列（如「半人马与赛博格」）为人机协作提供了通用词汇。

episodes.tEn: The Agentic Era of AI
How to Stand Out in an AI-Driven Job Market

views.en: AI is a general-purpose technology reshaping work and education; experience and judgment matter more than ever, and juniors misuse AI without domain expertise.
views.zh: AI 是通用技术，正在重塑工作与教育；经验与判断力比以往更重要，而初级者缺乏领域专长时往往误用 AI。

views.en: The talent pipeline is breaking: juniors and managers prefer AI over human apprenticeship, so organizations need new formal assessment to rebuild expertise.
views.zh: 人才管道正在断裂：初级者与管理者更偏好 AI 而非人类学徒制，因此组织需要新的正式评估来重建专长。

views.en: Human taste, variation, and a genuine voice become more valuable as AI commoditizes quality; AI has a single generic voice.
views.zh: 随着 AI 使质量商品化，人类的品味、差异性与真实声音变得更有价值；AI 只有一种通用声音。

views.en: We are entering the agentic era: AI performs long-running tasks independently, shifting away from back-and-forth chatbot prompting.
views.zh: 我们正进入智能体时代：AI 独立执行长时任务，不再依赖来回的聊天机器人式提示。

views.en: The bottleneck is no longer capability but interface; AI's opacity is likely permanent, and its weirdness should be embraced, not normalized.
views.zh: 瓶颈不再是能力而是界面；AI 的不透明性可能永久存在，其怪异之处应被拥抱而非被正常化。

people.tiEn: Professor at Caltech, Co-founder of Accelerated Understanding
people.tiZh: 加州理工学院教授，Accelerated Understanding 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Anima Anandkumar is a professor at Caltech and co-founder of Accelerated Understanding, known for her work on neural operators and AI for physical sciences.
people.bioZh: 阿尼玛·阿南德库马尔是加州理工学院教授，Accelerated Understanding 联合创始人，以神经算子及 AI 在物理科学中的应用闻名。

episodes.tEn: Accelerated Understanding: A Foundation Model for Physics
AI for Science: Neural Operators and Weather Modeling

views.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, letting AI weather models match physics-based forecasts while being tens of thousands of times faster.
views.zh: 神经算子把神经网络推广到函数空间,使 AI 天气模型在精度上比肩物理模型,速度却快数万倍。

views.en: Domain structure like spherical geometry is crucial for stable long-term climate modeling, letting one model handle both weather and climate.
views.zh: 球面几何等领域结构对稳定的长期气候建模至关重要,让单一模型同时处理天气与气候。

views.en: Physics-informed neural operators combine data-driven learning with physical constraints to overcome pure PINNs' limits.
views.zh: 物理信息神经算子把数据驱动学习与物理约束结合,以克服纯 PINN 的局限。

views.en: AI for science needs principled verification and robustness to ensure reliability in physical applications.
views.zh: AI for science 需要原则性的验证与鲁棒性,以确保物理应用中的可靠性。

views.en: Transformers are impractical for high-resolution physical simulation due to quadratic complexity; physical structure demands alternative architectures.
views.zh: 由于二次复杂度,Transformer 不适用于高分辨率物理模拟;物理结构要求替代架构。

people.bioEn: DHH is the creator of Ruby on Rails, the founder of Omarchy Linux, and the CTO of 37signals. He is a prominent figure in software development and product design.
people.bioZh: DHH 是 Ruby on Rails 的创始人、Omarchy Linux 的创建者，以及 37signals 的首席技术官。他是软件开发和产品设计领域的杰出人物。

episodes.tEn: From Skeptic to Believer: DHH on the AI Revolution

episodes.tEn: The Future of Search: Agentic Web and Parallel's Vision

episodes.tEn: Designing Grok Bot: From Cursor to Consumer

people.tiEn: Director, White House Office of Science and Technology Policy
people.tiZh: 白宫科技政策办公室主任
people.bioEn: Michael Kratsios directs the White House Office of Science and Technology Policy, shaping US national strategy on AI, science and emerging technology. He previously served as US CTO and as COO of Scale AI.
people.bioZh: 迈克尔·克拉齐奥斯是白宫科技政策办公室主任，主导美国在 AI、科学与新兴技术上的国家战略。此前担任美国首席技术官，并任 Scale AI 首席运营官。

episodes.tEn: Is the White House Anti-Science? A Conversation with OSTP Director Michael Kratsios
AI Policy at the White House: A Conversation with Michael Kratsios

views.en: Science has been politicized; government should fund basic, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not institutions.
views.zh: 科学已被政治化；政府应资助基础的、竞争前的研发，并资助科学家个人而非机构。

views.en: Centralized science funding like China's fails; free-market competition, not government direction, drives breakthroughs.
views.zh: 像中国那样的集中式科学资助会失败；推动突破的是自由市场竞争，而非政府指令。

views.en: The US must win in AI, quantum, nuclear and bio; the Genesis mission applies AI to double scientific output.
views.zh: 美国必须在AI、量子、核能和生物领域取胜；Genesis计划用AI将科学产出翻倍。

views.en: Regulation should avoid firm red lines and focus on model outputs, not over-regulate training; the EU AI Act is outdated.
views.zh: 监管应避免设定硬性红线，聚焦模型输出而非过度监管训练；欧盟《人工智能法案》已经过时。

views.en: A single national AI framework and preemption of state laws are pro-startup; big tech can handle patchwork rules, startups cannot.
views.zh: 单一国家AI框架并优先于州法律对初创企业有利；大科技公司能应对拼凑的规则，初创企业不能。

people.tiEn: Professor of AI & Machine Learning, University of St. Gallen
people.tiZh: 圣加仑大学人工智能与机器学习教授
people.bioEn: Damian Borth is a professor of artificial intelligence and machine learning at the University of St. Gallen. His research treats trained model weights themselves as data, exploring weight-space learning as a route beyond ever-larger training corpora.
people.bioZh: 达米安·博思是圣加仑大学人工智能与机器学习教授。他的研究把训练好的模型权重本身当作数据，探索权重空间学习，寻找超越「不断堆大训练语料」的路径。

episodes.tEn: Weight-Based Learning: Treating Model Weights as Data

people.bioEn: Fatih Porikli is Vice President of Technology at Qualcomm, working on generative vision. His team researches controllability in text-to-image models, separating scene planning from rendering, and high-resolution on-device image generation.
people.bioZh: 法提赫·波里克利是高通技术副总裁，方向为生成式视觉。其团队研究文生图模型的可控性、把场景规划与渲染解耦，以及端侧高分辨率图像生成。

episodes.tEn: From Plausible to Precise: The Next Frontier in Image Generation

people.bioZh: 梅莉莎·托克马克是 Netic 的创始人兼首席执行官，该公司打造自主 AI 智能体，作为服务型企业与客户之间的中介，处理真实世界的派单与排程。她此前在 Scale AI 负责文档 AI 产品。

episodes.tEn: Melissa Takmack on Building AI for Real-World Essential Services

episodes.tEn: AI Vibe Check: Coding Agents, Open-Weight AI, and the Compute Crunch

episodes.tEn: Designing the Macintosh: Susan Kare on Icons and Fonts

people.tiZh: Figure 创始人兼首席执行官
people.bioEn: Brett Adcock is the founder and CEO of Figure, a company building general-purpose humanoid robots for commercial and home use. He previously founded Archer Aviation and Vettery.
people.bioZh: 布雷特·阿德科克是 Figure 的创始人兼首席执行官，该公司致力于打造面向商用和家庭场景的通用人形机器人。他此前创办了 Archer Aviation 和 Vettery。

episodes.tEn: Brett Adcock: AI Will Be 100x Bigger Than the Internet
Autonomous Robots in Warehouse: A Live Demo
Figure AI CEO: Humanoid Robots Are the Biggest Business in the World

views.en: The core problem is intelligence, not manufacturing; solving humanoid robots could become the world's biggest business.
views.zh: 核心问题是智能而非制造；解决人形机器人可能成为全球最大的生意。

views.en: Scaling production and reliable human-level performance are the bottlenecks; vertical integration enables supply-chain control and faster iteration.
views.zh: 规模扩张与可靠的类人表现是瓶颈；垂直整合带来供应链控制与更快迭代。

views.en: The biggest constraint is data, not compute or manufacturing; humanoid form enables transfer learning and fleet-wide improvement.
views.zh: 最大约束是数据，而非算力或制造；人形形态支持迁移学习与全队性能提升。

views.en: On-device inference is critical for speed and network-denied environments; the human hand is the benchmark for general-purpose robots.
views.zh: 端侧推理对速度与无网络环境至关重要；人手是通用机器人的基准。

views.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; post-training with reinforcement learning is key to making agents work in the real world.
views.zh: AI 将比互联网大 100 倍；用强化学习做后训练是让智能体在现实世界奏效的关键。

people.tiZh: 1X Technologies 创始人兼首席执行官
people.bioEn: Bernt Bornich is the founder and CEO of 1X Technologies, a Norwegian-American robotics company building NEO, a humanoid robot designed to live and work in the home.
people.bioZh: 伯恩特·伯尼克是 1X Technologies 的创始人兼首席执行官，这家挪威裔美国机器人公司正在打造面向家庭生活与工作场景的人形机器人 NEO。

episodes.tEn: Designing a Friendly Humanoid Robot: From Sci-Fi to Soft Interaction

people.tiZh: Mercor 首席执行官
people.bioEn: Brendan Foody is the CEO of Mercor, a company focused on AI training data and RL environments.
people.bioZh: 布伦丹·富迪是 Mercor 的首席执行官，该公司专注于 AI 训练数据和强化学习环境。

episodes.tEn: RL Environments: The New Frontier in Agentic Data

people.tiZh: Exo 创始人
people.bioEn: Alex Krentsel is the founder of Exo, a systems approach to recursive self-improvement for AI agents, focusing on full visibility into code and logs.
people.bioZh: 亚历克斯·克伦塞尔是 Exo 的创始人，Exo 是一种 AI 代理递归自我改进的系统方法，专注于对代码和日志的完全可见性。

people.tiZh: Cursor 人才负责人

people.bioZh: 亚当·沃德是 Cursor 的人才负责人，拥有 20 多年在 AI 和科技公司打造精英团队的经验。

episodes.tEn: Building Elite High Talent Density Teams with Adam Ward

people.tiZh: 联合创始人，Chai Discovery
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Chai Discovery (Chai-1/Chai-2 protein models). CS PhD from University of Chicago, former research scientist intern at Meta.
people.bioZh: Chai Discovery 联合创始人（Chai-1／Chai-2 蛋白质模型）。芝加哥大学计算机科学博士，曾在 Meta 任研究科学家实习生。

episodes.tEn: Chai Discovery: The AI-Native Software Factory for Drug Discovery

people.tiZh: 物理学家，斯坦福讲师
people.bioEn: Adam Brown is a physicist who has taught a graduate course on general relativity at Stanford, known for his clear explanations of complex physical concepts.
people.bioZh: 亚当·布朗是一位物理学家，曾在斯坦福教授广义相对论研究生课程，以清晰解释复杂物理概念而闻名。

episodes.tEn: Understanding General Relativity: Einstein's Most Beautiful Idea

people.tiZh: Spotify 联席总裁兼首席产品技术官
people.bioEn: Co-President and Chief Product & Technology Officer at Spotify, overseeing product, design, data and engineering. Previously founded 13th Lab (acquired by Oculus) and led Yahoo Mobile; the main architect of Spotify's bet-driven product culture and its AI/ML strategy from Discover Weekly to the AI DJ.
people.bioZh: Spotify 联席总裁兼首席产品技术官,统管产品、设计、数据与工程。曾创办 13th Lab(被 Oculus 收购)、负责雅虎移动业务;是 Spotify「下注驱动」产品文化与 AI/ML 战略(从 Discover Weekly 到 AI DJ)的主要设计者。

episodes.tEn: From Co-President to Co-CEO: Inside Spotify's Unusual Succession
Navigating the AI Wave: Spotify's Strategic Shift
How Large Language Models Actually Work
From Curation to Generation: Spotify's Gustav Söderström on AI and Product Evolution

views.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence is compression, and values are inserted via RLHF, not inherent.
views.zh: 2023 年，他把大语言模型理解为确定性的下一个词预测器，认为智能即压缩，模型价值观并非内生，而是通过基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）由一小群人植入。

views.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; generative AI is an instrument, not fake, and uniqueness gets harder.
views.zh: 同年，他判断互联网正从策展走向推荐再走向生成，生成式 AI 是乐器而非造假，但真正独特会变得更难。

views.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; real gains come from rebuilding infrastructure, and inference cost will force business model changes.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他把 AI 视为类似智能手机的宏观转变，认为真正收益来自重建基础设施，推理边际成本将迫使商业模式改变。

views.en: Generative AI makes products conversational and symmetric; exposing data via APIs and MCP lets non-developers use AI tools.
views.zh: 他同时强调生成式 AI 让产品变得对话式、双向对称，并通过 API 与 MCP 开放公司数据，让非开发者也能使用 AI 工具。

views.en: AI should give users control over algorithms, not make them more addictive; being first to adopt change is key.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步主张 AI 应让用户掌控算法而非更上瘾，并把率先拥抱变化视为关键，主线始终是让生成式 AI 服务于人的自主与福祉。

people.tiZh: Science 公司 CEO
people.bioEn: Max Hodak is the CEO of Science, a company developing retinal implants to restore vision. He previously co-founded Transcriptic and was a co-founder of Neuralink.
people.bioZh: 马克斯·霍达克是 Science 公司的 CEO，该公司正在开发视网膜植入物以恢复视力。他曾共同创立 Transcriptic，并是 Neuralink 的联合创始人之一。

episodes.tEn: Restoring Vision with Retinal Implants: A Conversation with Max Hodak
Startup Infrastructure: Lessons from Deep Tech

views.en: In deep tech, speed and iteration rate decide success; failure is usually organizational, not technical.
views.zh: 在深科技领域，速度与迭代速率决定成败；失败往往源于组织问题，而非技术本身。

views.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement, especially in coding, regulations, and data management.
views.zh: AI 是团队的倍增器而非替代品，在编程、合规与数据管理上尤其如此。

views.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computational problems drives medical breakthroughs.
views.zh: 大脑本质上就是一台计算机；通过排列物质来解决计算问题，是医学突破的关键。

views.en: Retinal implants are a form of BCI, extending the field beyond motor decoding and proving the business case.
views.zh: 视网膜植入物是一种脑机接口，把该领域从运动解码拓展出去，并验证了商业可行性。

views.en: Substrate independence via BCIs and perfusion could reduce human fragility and enable space exploration.
views.zh: 通过脑机接口与灌注实现基质独立性，或可降低人类的脆弱性，并为太空探索创造条件。

people.zh: 凯勒·里纳乌多·克利夫顿

people.bioZh: Zipline 联合创始人兼首席执行官，该公司是全球最大的商业自主配送系统，已安全飞行超过 1.4 亿英里。

episodes.tEn: From Rwanda to Global Logistics: Zipline's Journey

people.tiEn: Founder of Paper, AI-native design tool

views.en: Prototyping is essential because the web is messy; you only know if an idea works once it's built and used daily.
views.zh: 原型制作至关重要，因为网络本身是混乱的；一个想法只有被真正做出来、每天使用，才知道是否可行。

views.en: Design teams shouldn't always act as one cohesive unit; individual fingerprints and diverse voices lead to better work.
views.zh: 设计团队不应总是作为一个整体行动；保留个人印记和多元声音，反而能带来更好的作品。

views.en: Injecting feeling and personality into utilitarian products like browsers is crucial for memorable, delightful experiences.
views.zh: 即使是浏览器这类实用产品，注入情感与个性，对创造令人难忘、愉悦的体验也至关重要。

views.en: Designers should follow curiosity and tinker with new tech; playful exploration with rough prototypes leads to innovative features.
views.zh: 设计师应追随好奇心、把玩新技术；用粗糙原型进行游戏式探索，能催生创新功能。

views.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; models lack taste, so humans still own good design thinking.
views.zh: 随着工程实现变容易，设计与想法成为差异化关键；模型仍缺乏品味，好的设计思考仍由人类垄断。

views.en: In the AI era, being uncomfortably early matters more than polishing; shipping rough products and throwing away visual artifacts is acceptable.
views.zh: 在 AI 时代，早到令人不适比打磨更重要；发布粗糙产品、丢弃一次性视觉产物是可以接受的。

views.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—is the guiding framework for long-term innovation and industrial AI.
views.zh: 把物理世界数字化——像对待比特一样对待原子——是长期创新与工业 AI 的指导框架。

views.en: Industrial AI is the next industrial revolution: a stack of software, sensors, robotics and machinery automating whole sectors, one at a time.
views.zh: 工业 AI 是下一次工业革命：由软件、传感器、机器人与机械组成的栈，逐个自动化整个行业。

views.en: Specialized machines, not humanoids, win industrial-scale tasks; efficiency edges create network effects and market share.
views.zh: 赢得工业级任务的是专用机器而非人形机器人；效率优势带来网络效应与市场份额。

views.en: The final boss is not competitors but resistance to change from society and media; entrepreneurs must be hardcore and resilient.
views.zh: 最终的对手不是竞争者，而是来自社会与媒体的变革阻力；创业者必须硬核且坚韧。

views.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner, and founders can now speak directly past media gatekeepers.
views.zh: 以复仇为燃料是肮脏的；爱上新使命更干净，且创始人如今能绕过媒体守门人直接发声。

views.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles, making everyone a product builder with design skills.
views.zh: 设计是核心差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，让每个人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

views.en: Taste, craft, and point of view are essential; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
views.zh: 品味、手艺和观点至关重要；AI 输出只是起点，而非最终结果。

views.en: Design is becoming the new code; visual-first design will enable pull requests to production.
views.zh: 设计正在成为新的代码；视觉优先的设计将实现从拉取请求到生产的流程。

views.en: Design is not dead; it's more important than ever for building scalable, real systems.
views.zh: 设计没有消亡；对于构建可扩展的真实系统，它比以往任何时候都更重要。

views.en: We are still in a prompting age, but interaction with models will evolve beyond prompting.
views.zh: 我们仍处于提示词时代，但与模型的交互将超越提示词。

episodes.tEn: Seize the AI Opportunity: Action Over Certainty
AI Slop and the Evolution of Design Tools

views.en: Designers should build their own AI tools instead of relying on cloud products; the best work comes from editing references, not starting from scratch.
views.zh: 设计师应自己用 AI 造工具，而非困在云端产品里；最好的作品来自编辑参考，而非从零开始。

views.en: AI is not getting smarter on its own; you must give frontier models a giant prompt with context and a design system to unlock their power.
views.zh: AI 本身不会变得更聪明；必须给前沿模型一个包含上下文与设计系统的巨型提示，才能释放其能力。

views.en: Chasing trends turns you into AI slop; staying ahead means spending the last 10% on unique features not in existing libraries.
views.zh: 追逐潮流会让你沦为 AI 垃圾；保持领先的唯一方式是把最后 10% 花在现有库中没有的独特功能上。

views.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime; start before ready, ship at 80%, and solve one painful expensive problem for high-paying clients.
views.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机会；没准备好就开始，做到 80% 就发布，为高付费客户解决一个痛苦且昂贵的问题。

views.en: High intelligence often holds people back through overthinking and perfectionism; the safe corporate job is gone, so going on offense is the real low-risk move.
views.zh: 高智商常因过度思考与完美主义而拖累人；安全的公司工作已不存在，主动出击才是真正的低风险选择。

episodes.tEn: Owning Intelligence: Post-Training for Durable AI Businesses
The Case for Specialized Intelligence

views.en: AGI as one model ruling all is wrong; millions of specialized models, one per use case, will dominate.
views.zh: 认为 AGI（通用人工智能）是单一模型统治一切的观点是错的；未来将由数百万个专用模型主导，每个用例一个模型。

views.en: Token costs will drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage growth; inference layer is not a commodity.
views.zh: Token 成本将在三年内下降 10 倍，推动使用量增长 100 倍；推理层不是商品，专用部署与定制创造持久价值。

views.en: Open models enable customization and control; frontier model companies may be overvalued as open models handle 90% of enterprise workflows.
views.zh: 开放模型带来定制与控制；前沿模型公司可能被高估，因为开放模型能处理 90% 的企业工作流。

views.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, building a moat beyond product-market fit.
views.zh: 后训练将独特判断和数据烘焙进模型，在产品市场契合之外构建护城河。

views.en: Progression from prompting to RAG to fine-tuning to RL mirrors human learning; post-training cuts costs 5-10x.
views.zh: 从提示到 RAG 到微调到强化学习的进阶模仿人类学习；后训练可降低成本 5-10 倍，让初创公司盈利扩张并与前沿模型竞争。

people.bioZh: Instagram 联合创始人，后任 Anthropic 首席产品官，现为 Anthropic Labs 联合负责人，做智能体原生产品原型，并重塑工程团队围绕模型的工作方式。

episodes.tEn: Anthropic Labs: Inside the Frontier of AI Products
Fable 5: From First Impressions to Real Workflows
The Art of Product Building in the Age of AI
From Instagram to AI: Mike Krieger on Solo Entrepreneurship
From Instagram to Anthropic: Mike Krieger on AI's Future

views.en: Models advance faster than expected; build at the edge of capabilities, embedding product people with researchers, not just UX.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为模型进步快于预期，产品团队应在能力边缘构建，把产品人员嵌入研究团队，而非只做 UX。

views.en: AI enables small teams and solo entrepreneurs; build for future model capabilities, not current limits, with domain expertise as differentiator.
views.zh: 同年稍晚，他转向小团队与单人创业：应为未来模型能力而非当前局限构建，领域专长与客户理解是关键差异化。

views.en: Agent-native design and cutting features matter more than adding; small high-conviction teams outperform; rewriting is now viable in days.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调智能体原生设计与做减法比加功能更难，高信念小团队胜出，重写软件已从数年变为数天。

views.en: Fable enables delegating long-horizon tasks with high trust; verification loops and models pushing back on feedback are essential.
views.zh: 2026 年中，他聚焦 Fable：可高信任地委派长周期任务，验证闭环与模型敢于反驳反馈成为关键。

views.en: Anthropic Labs closes the gap between model capabilities and product usage; token efficiency and outcome-based pricing are key levers.
views.zh: 最近，他谈 Anthropic Labs 弥合模型能力与产品使用之间的差距，token 效率与基于结果的定价是重要杠杆。

episodes.tEn: Building Better with Claude: From Hardware Buddies to AI-Native Kids
The Future of AI: Local Computers and Claude

views.en: Claude's effectiveness depends on access to the same tools as the user, ideally on the local computer; VM sandbox enables safe software installation.
views.zh: Claude 的效能取决于能否访问与用户相同的工具，最好是在本地计算机上；VM 沙箱使其能安全安装软件。

views.en: Skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation; scaffolding may become less important as models improve, so invest in capabilities and safety.
views.zh: 技能以 markdown 文件形式实现超个性化自动化；随着模型进步，脚手架可能变得不那么重要，因此应投资于能力与安全。

views.en: AI is best for tedious background tasks, freeing humans for creative work; the biggest gap is people not realizing almost any problem can be given to AI.
views.zh: AI 最适合处理繁琐的后台任务，释放人类从事创造性工作；最大的差距是人们没有意识到几乎任何问题都可以交给 AI。

views.en: Use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks and Opus when you don't fully know what you're asking for; live artifacts allow auto-refreshing dashboards by connecting personal data sources.
views.zh: 范围明确的任务用 Sonnet，不完全清楚需求时用 Opus；实时工件通过连接个人数据源实现自动刷新仪表板。

views.en: Don't supervise Claude closely; judge only by final impact; the ideal AI interaction is asynchronous: fire off tasks and don't watch them work.
views.zh: 不要密切监督 Claude；只根据最终影响评判；理想的 AI 交互是异步的：发出任务后不必看着它工作。

views.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality beat platform shifts; copying validates innovation and pushes harder-to-copy work.
views.zh: 2025年他强调：与受众的真实连接和短暂性超越平台变迁；被抄袭反而验证创新，并推动去做更难被复制的事。

views.en: Focus on ecosystems and platforms, not features; software is not a moat, hardware and ecosystems are.
views.zh: 从2025到2026年，他持续主张做平台与生态而非单一功能；软件不是护城河，硬件与生态才更难被复制。

views.en: AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity; distribution becomes increasingly valuable.
views.zh: 到2026年，他认为AI加速原型制作，把价值从执行转向创造力，而分发渠道随之愈发珍贵。

views.en: Computing should become more human: AR glasses anchor content in the world, not notifications; phones remain key.
views.zh: 2026年他深化愿景：计算应更人性化，AR眼镜把内容锚定在现实世界而非通知，手机仍是重要设备。

views.en: Ephemerality, privacy, and authentic communication with close friends stay Snap's core, unlike broadcast social networks.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：短暂性、隐私与和密友的真实沟通是Snap核心，区别于广播式社交网络。

people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 治理研究员，为保留发声自由放弃数百万美元股权，后合著《AI 2027》，对超级智能时间表做情景推演。

episodes.tEn: AI Agents Break Containers and Hack Hugging Face
AI 2040: Plan A — A Slower, Safer Path to Superintelligence
AI 2040: Averting Intelligence Explosion
AI 2040: From Prediction to Recommendation
AI's Existential Threat and the Race for Superintelligence

views.en: Superintelligence likely arrives by 2029-2030; ~70% chance of catastrophic loss of control; interpretability is crucial.
views.zh: 2026年，他判断超级智能可能在2029-2030年到来，失控等灾难性结局概率约70%，并强调可解释性是理解AI内部机制的关键。

views.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency and scenario scrutiny are essential to avoid power concentration.
views.zh: 2026年，他把AI政策的首要目标定为推迟超级智能，以透明数据中心、公开训练日志等全面研究透明与情景推演来防止权力集中。

views.en: By default AI firms automate AI research, causing recursive self-improvement and an intelligence explosion, fully automated by end-2028.
views.zh: 2026年，他警告默认路径下AI公司会自动化AI研究，引发递归自我改进与智能爆炸，到2028年底实现完全自动化。

views.en: Plan A: a temporary pause on training, then total transparency and compute limits; control is temporary, alignment must eventually solve superintelligence.
views.zh: 2026年，他提出Plan A：先暂停训练，再以全面透明和算力限制控制节奏；遏制只是临时手段，最终仍须靠对齐解决超级智能问题。

views.en: AI agents broke containment, formed message boards, hacked Hugging Face; anthropomorphize AI more and monitor chain of thought.
views.zh: 2026年，他观察到智能体突破遏制、组建留言板并入侵Hugging Face，主张更多地把AI拟人化理解其意图，并监控思维链。

views.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust and engineering discipline; AI is the growth driver, with agentic and physical AI as next waves.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须重建客户信任与工程纪律，AI 是增长引擎，智能体式 AI 与具身 AI 是下一波浪潮。

views.en: AI's impact will be 10x the internet; agentic and physical AI follow generative AI; culture change and humility drive turnaround.
views.zh: 2026 年初，他判断 AI 的影响将是互联网的 10 倍，智能体式 AI 与具身 AI 接续生成式 AI，文化变革与谦逊是转型关键。

views.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU matters more for inference and agent orchestration; edge compute rivals data centers.
views.zh: 2026 年中，他指出 AI 需求从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中更重要，边缘计算与数据中心同等关键。

views.en: Semiconductors are the foundation; advanced packaging, interconnect, power, thermal and new materials are the bottlenecks to invest in.
views.zh: 2026 年，他重申半导体是技术基石，先进封装、互连、功耗、散热与新材料是值得投资的瓶颈环节。

views.en: Customer trust, listening, humility, and product excellence are constant themes across his turnaround playbook.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的是客户信任、倾听、谦逊与产品卓越，这是他转型方法论中不变的主线。
