people.tiEn: Lead, Google AI Studio & Gemini API; ex-OpenAI
people.tiZh: Google AI Studio 与 Gemini API 负责人；前 OpenAI
people.bioEn: Leads Google AI Studio and the Gemini API, shaping how developers build on frontier models. Previously led developer relations at OpenAI.
people.bioZh: 负责 Google AI Studio 与 Gemini API，塑造开发者在前沿模型上的构建方式。此前在 OpenAI 领导开发者关系。

episodes.tEn: Outsource Intelligence but Not Understanding: Logan Kilpatrick on AI Pace and Sanity
Agentic AI Era: Google's Anti-Gravity Harness Powers Next-Gen Products

views.en: Agentic AI is still early; coding agents are the most mature use case, and the model now includes the agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
views.zh: 智能体式 AI 仍处早期，编程智能体是最成熟的用例；如今所谓模型已包含智能体框架与工具链，而不只是权重。

views.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI; other verticals like science and finance will follow.
views.zh: 编程领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，比等待 AGI（通用人工智能）更有影响力；科学、金融等垂直领域将随之跟进。

views.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement, not cannibalistic; success should mean maximizing customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
views.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和的，而非自相残杀；成功标准应是最大化客户成果，而非产品上的眼球时长。

views.en: The long tail of users isn't ready for fully autonomous AI; they want to stay in the driver's seat, so containment and oversight matter.
views.zh: 长尾用户尚未准备好接受完全自主的 AI，他们想继续掌握方向盘，因此遏制与监督很重要。

views.en: Deep understanding of code stays crucial even as AI tools advance; software creation will be mostly solved, creating far more opportunity, not less.
views.zh: 即便 AI 工具进步，对代码的深度理解仍至关重要；软件创造将基本被解决，带来的是更多而非更少的机会。

people.tiZh: Engram 联合创始人；记忆与持续学习
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Engram, a lab building around memory and continual learning for AI. Researcher focused on how models retain and update knowledge over time.
people.bioZh: Engram 联合创始人，该实验室专注 AI 的记忆与持续学习。研究模型如何随时间保留并更新知识。

episodes.tEn: From Special Forces to AI: Dan Biderman's Journey
Memory and Continual Learning: The Next Frontier in AI

views.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
views.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进权重，而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

views.en: Facts and skills are not separable; internalizing facts enables deeper composition and reasoning than retrieval systems can achieve.
views.zh: 事实与技能不可分割；将事实内化进权重，才能实现检索系统无法企及的深层组合与推理。

views.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models for every individual or team, running on-device with users owning their weights.
views.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是为每个人或团队定制的众多个性化模型，在端侧运行、由用户拥有其权重。

views.en: Scaling with more compute is not the only path; the next paradigm requires doing more with less, as efficiency and intelligence are inseparable.
views.zh: 堆算力做 Scaling 并非唯一路径；下一范式要求以更少做更多，因为效率与智能不可分割。

views.en: Continual learning is the next frontier, requiring new research breakthroughs, small-model infrastructure, and integrated research-product loops.
views.zh: 持续学习是下一前沿，需要新的研究突破、小模型基础设施，以及研究—产品一体化的闭环。

people.tiZh: MatX 联合创始人兼 CEO；前 Google（大模型推理）
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of MatX, building chips designed specifically for large language models. Previously at Google, where he worked on high-performance LLM training and serving.
people.bioZh: MatX 联合创始人兼 CEO，专为大语言模型打造芯片。此前在 Google 从事高性能大模型训练与推理。

episodes.tEn: How AI Chips Work: From Logic Gates to Matrix Multiplication
AI Inference Economics: Batch Size, Latency, and Cost

views.en: Inference economics, not training, now drives architecture: batch size trades latency for cost, and memory bandwidth—not compute—is the bottleneck.
views.zh: 到2026年，推理经济而非训练成为架构设计的驱动力：批大小在延迟与成本间权衡，瓶颈是内存带宽而非算力。

views.en: Long-context and context-window stagnation stem from the memory wall; sparse attention cuts KV cache cost but has quality limits.
views.zh: 长上下文与上下文窗口的停滞源于内存墙；稀疏注意力能降低KV缓存成本，但存在质量上限。

views.en: Data movement dominates compute even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory exist to minimize it.
views.zh: 即便在芯片内部，数据搬运的成本也压过计算；脉动阵列与暂存内存正是为最小化搬运而存在。

views.en: Low precision is far more efficient than expected: quadratic area scaling with bit width makes FP4 ~3x FP8, not 2x.
views.zh: 低精度的效率远超预期：面积随位宽二次增长，使FP4吞吐约为FP8的3倍而非2倍。

views.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together; the divide is market preference, not fundamental architecture.
views.zh: GPU本质上只是许多小TPU的拼接；二者的分野是市场偏好，而非根本架构差异。

people.bioEn: Founder and chief analyst of SemiAnalysis, the closely-followed research firm covering semiconductors, AI compute, and datacenter economics. One of the most-cited independent voices on the hardware bottlenecks to scaling AI.
people.bioZh: SemiAnalysis 创始人兼首席分析师，该机构专注半导体、AI 算力与数据中心经济学。他是关于 AI 扩展硬件瓶颈最常被引用的独立声音之一。

episodes.tEn: AI Labs' Compute Dominance and Economics
AI Spend Plateaus as Agents Become Coworkers
From Forum Poster to AI Infrastructure Analyst: The Story of Semi Analysis
From Motel to Semi Analysis: Dylan Patel's Journey
Hyperscaler Capex and AI Lab Compute Scaling

views.en: Scaling's bottleneck is the semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV; compute economics, not just tech, drive AI.
views.zh: 2026年3月，他认为Scaling（规模扩张）的最大瓶颈是半导体供应链，尤其是EUV光刻设备；驱动AI的不只是技术，更是算力经济学。

views.en: Inference will become one of the largest global markets; hardware-software co-design yields multiplicative gains.
views.zh: 2026年6月，他深化判断：推理将成为全球最大市场之一，硬件-软件协同设计能带来乘数级收益。

views.en: Model cost per quality improves ~60x/year; memory and CPU demand surge from reasoning and agentic workflows.
views.zh: 2026年7月，他量化模型进步：同等质量下成本每年改善约60倍；推理模型与智能体式工作流推高内存和CPU需求。

views.en: AI spend plateaus as agents become coworkers; persistent agents drive the next adoption wave.
views.zh: 2026年8月17日，他观察到AI支出进入平台期，因为智能体开始充当同事；持久化智能体将驱动下一波采用。

views.en: Compute centralizes at frontier labs; labs shift compute to training/R&D, not inference, accelerating AGI.
views.zh: 2026年8月25日，他进一步判断：算力正快速向少数前沿模型实验室集中；实验室将更多算力投向训练与研发而非推理，以加速AGI（通用人工智能）进程。

people.tiZh: Linux 基金会 AI CTO；PyTorch 基金会执行董事
people.bioEn: AI CTO at the Linux Foundation and Executive Director of the PyTorch Foundation. A champion of open-source AI who works across frontier labs — recently touring DeepSeek, Moonshot, Zhipu, Qwen and MiniMax to see China's open-model ecosystem firsthand.
people.bioZh: Linux 基金会 AI CTO、PyTorch 基金会执行董事。开源 AI 的推动者，近期走访 DeepSeek、月之暗面、智谱、Qwen 与 MiniMax，一线观察中国开源模型生态。

episodes.tEn: AI CTO at Linux Foundation on Open Source AI, China's Rise, and Agentic AI

people.tiZh: Zynga 创始人
people.bioEn: Founder of Zynga, the company behind FarmVille and Words with Friends. A serial product founder known for the Proven-Better-New framework and sharp instincts about what makes products spread, now writing about play and product craft.
people.bioZh: Zynga 创始人——FarmVille、Words with Friends 背后的公司。连续产品创业者，以 Proven-Better-New 框架与对产品传播的敏锐直觉著称，近来书写游戏心态与产品之道。

episodes.tEn: Mark Pincus on AI, Investing, and Life at the Speed of Play
Building Failure Machines: The Zynga Way
Building Products People Love: A Playbook for the AI Era
Mark Pincus on Proven Better New: A Framework for Successful Product Ideas

views.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable now yet the greatest opportunity; the real revolution likely lands around 2029.
views.zh: 消费级 AI 眼下不可投，却也是最大的机会；真正的革命大概要到 2029 年才落地。

views.en: Proven Better New: copy proven products, add small betterments, test new ideas assuming they fail.
views.zh: ‘成熟、更好、全新’框架：复制成熟产品，做小幅改良，测试全新想法时默认它们会失败。

views.en: Distribution must be baked into product strategy from day one, not treated as an afterthought.
views.zh: 分发必须从第一天就嵌入产品战略，而不是事后才补的环节。

views.en: AI coding tools enable fast prototyping, but fast testing and failing is still rarely practiced.
views.zh: AI 编程工具让快速原型成为可能，但快速测试与快速失败仍鲜有人实践。

views.en: Picking the right body of water matters more than the boat; AI will reshape consumer applications.
views.zh: 选对水域比选对船更重要；AI 将重塑消费级应用。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 前沿评估负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the frontier evaluations team at OpenAI, building new ways to measure and forecast what models can do as they grow more capable. A researcher focused on rigorous evals.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 前沿评估团队负责人，为日益强大的模型设计新的能力测量与预测方法。专注严谨评测的研究者。

episodes.tEn: Building Crunchier Evals: Tejal Patwardhan on Measuring AI Progress

people.tiZh: World Labs 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of World Labs with Fei-Fei Li, building spatial intelligence and generative 3D world models. Earlier a computer-vision researcher known for teaching Stanford CS231n and work on style transfer.
people.bioZh: 与李飞飞联合创办 World Labs，研究空间智能与生成式 3D 世界模型。此前是计算机视觉研究者，以讲授斯坦福 CS231n 与风格迁移工作知名。

episodes.tEn: World Models: The Next Frontier in AI
From AlexNet to World Models: The Scaling of Compute and Spatial Intelligence

views.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier after language; vision is underappreciated and pixels are more lossless than tokens.
views.zh: 空间智能是语言之后的下一个前沿；视觉被低估，像素比 token 更无损。

views.en: The history of deep learning is the history of scaling compute; but GPU scaling is hitting limits, requiring new architectures.
views.zh: 深度学习史就是算力规模扩张史；但 GPU 规模扩张正触及极限，需要全新架构。

views.en: Academia should focus on wacky ideas and new algorithms, not just scaling models.
views.zh: 学术界应聚焦古怪想法与新算法，而非只做模型规模扩张。

views.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models, with no single definition; they include implicit, generative, and RL-based notions.
views.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿，没有统一定义；涵盖隐式、生成式与基于强化学习的理念。

views.en: Future unified world models will combine planning, simulation, and rendering; long-context and loss functions need evolution.
views.zh: 未来统一的世界模型将融合规划、模拟与渲染；长上下文窗口与损失函数需要演进。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机器人负责人
people.bioEn: Senior Director and Head of Robotics at Google DeepMind, leading robot-learning efforts including the Gemini Robotics models that bring foundation models into the physical world.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 机器人负责人（高级总监），领导机器人学习工作，包括把基础模型带入物理世界的 Gemini Robotics 模型。

episodes.tEn: From Reinforcement Learning to Gemini Robotics: The Evolution of Embodied AI

people.tiZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员
people.bioEn: Interpretability researcher at Anthropic known for work on the biology of large language models — reverse-engineering the features and circuits inside models to see how they actually compute.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员，以大语言模型的生物学研究知名——逆向拆解模型内部的特征与电路，看清它到底如何计算。

episodes.tEn: On the Biology of a Large Language Model

people.tiZh: Core Automation 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Core Automation, building what he calls the most automated AI lab in the world. Spent nearly seven years at OpenAI as VP of Research, where he led the o1/o3 reasoning effort and was the primary researcher behind Codex; left in January 2026 saying that kind of fundamental research was no longer possible there.
people.bioZh: Core Automation 联合创始人兼 CEO，目标是造出「世界上最自动化的 AI 实验室」。此前在 OpenAI 近七年、任研究副总裁，主导 o1／o3 推理方向，也是 Codex 的主要研究者；2026 年 1 月离开，理由是那类基础研究在那里已经做不了了。

episodes.tEn: The Third Generation of AI Labs: Automating AI Research
Learning from Experience: Beyond Reinforcement Learning and Transformers
Scaling AI: Pre-training and RL
OpenAI's VP of Research on Reasoning, Chain of Thought, and the Future of AI

views.en: Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula; RLHF unlocked GPT-4, and scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training.
views.zh: 2025 年他强调：预训练加强化学习是核心公式，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）才让 GPT-4 真正可用；而 Scaling（规模扩张）强化学习比 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练更难，因为变量与失败模式更多。

views.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization and self-correction remain limited; continual learning is missing for AGI.
views.zh: 到 2026 年初，他一方面承认 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，另一方面指出泛化与自我纠错仍受限，持续学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的一环，单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）强化学习未必足够。

views.en: Transformers limit continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is now the key bottleneck.
views.zh: 2026 年中，他的立场明显深化：Transformer 在持续学习与测试时适应上有局限，架构而非缩放定律才是当前关键瓶颈，需要新架构与更好的优化算法，强化学习也并非从经验中学习的终极形式。

views.en: Large-scale RL is necessary for AGI, but the transformer is likely not optimal; small teams with capable agents will drive frontier research.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他仍坚持大规模强化学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的必要元素，但更明确判断 Transformer 很可能不是最优架构，下一波前沿研究将来自使用高能力智能体的小团队，而非仅靠算力堆叠的大实验室。

views.en: Alignment is never-ending because human notions of right and wrong evolve; models can still be misaligned if environments are poorly designed.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：对齐是永无止境的追求，因为人类对是非的观念随时间演变；若环境设计不当，模型仍可能失准，因此对齐问题并未解决。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员
people.bioEn: Mechanistic interpretability researcher at Anthropic, working on superposition, dictionary learning and circuit tracing to understand what actually happens inside large models.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 机制可解释性研究员，研究叠加、字典学习与电路追踪，试图搞清大模型内部到底发生了什么。

episodes.tEn: RL for Language Models Finally Works: Expert Performance in Math and Code

people.tiEn: VP of Research (AI for Science), Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁（AI 科学）
people.bioEn: VP of Research at Google DeepMind, where he leads AI for Science. His teams apply AI to protein folding, mathematics, materials and other scientific frontiers.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁，主管 AI for Science。其团队把 AI 用于蛋白质折叠、数学、材料等科学前沿。

episodes.tEn: AlphaGo: The Match That Changed AI Forever
AlphaFold 3: Unlocking the Structures of Life's Molecules

views.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications; AlphaFold, GraphCast, GNOME and FunSearch show broad impact.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调科学 AI 应瞄准根节点问题而非狭窄应用，AlphaFold、GraphCast、GNOME 与 FunSearch 展示了广泛影响。

views.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors; AI must be forced to generalize, not memorize.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为大语言模型的幻觉在配合真值检测器时可被用于创造性发现；AI 必须被强制泛化而非记忆。

views.en: Material science is more experimental than biology; AI impact there will take 5-10 years, and DeepMind avoids problems solvable by top universities.
views.zh: 2024 年，他指出材料科学比生物学更依赖实验，AI 影响需 5-10 年；DeepMind 避开顶尖大学能解决的问题，专注需要 Scaling（规模扩张）的难题。

views.en: AlphaGo combined intuition and calculation; Move 37 showed AI can produce insights beyond human knowledge, a transition point.
views.zh: 2026 年，他回顾 AlphaGo 结合直觉与计算，第 37 手表明 AI 能产生超越人类知识的洞见，是 AI 超越人类智能的转折点。

views.en: LLMs are a shortcut to intelligence but struggle to go beyond human data; post-training with reinforcement learning is key, and verifiable domains like code are crucial.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：大语言模型是通往智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据；后训练结合强化学习是关键，代码等可验证领域至关重要。

people.tiZh: AI 研究员（前 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: AI researcher known as a co-creator of chain-of-thought prompting, and for work on o1 and Deep Research. A prominent voice on reasoning and emergent abilities in large models.
people.bioZh: AI 研究员，思维链提示的共同提出者之一，参与 o1 与 Deep Research。是大模型推理与涌现能力方面的重要声音。

episodes.tEn: Intelligence as a Commodity: Three Key Trends for AI in 2025

people.tiZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CTO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CTO of Reflection AI and a co-creator of AlphaGo and AlphaZero at DeepMind. A reinforcement-learning researcher turned frontier-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CTO，DeepMind 时期是 AlphaGo 与 AlphaZero 的共同创造者。从强化学习研究者转向前沿智能体的构建者。

episodes.tEn: From AlphaGo to AI Agents: Giannis on Breakthroughs in Reinforcement Learning

people.tiEn: Head of AGI Safety & Alignment, Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind AGI 安全与对齐负责人
people.bioEn: Head of AGI Safety and Alignment at Google DeepMind. A leading voice on interpretability, oversight and how to make advanced AI systems safe from the inside.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind AGI 安全与对齐负责人。在可解释性、监督以及如何从内部让先进 AI 系统更安全方面是重要声音。

episodes.tEn: Why AI Alignment Might Not Be Catastrophic: Rohan Sha's Optimistic Take

people.tiZh: Wayve 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Wayve and a PhD roboticist who pioneered end-to-end learned autonomous driving and generative driving world models. A champion of embodied AI.
people.bioZh: Wayve 联合创始人兼 CEO，机器人学博士，开创了端到端学习的自动驾驶与生成式驾驶世界模型。倡导具身智能。

episodes.tEn: From Farm to Frontier: Alex Kendall on Wayve's End-to-End AI for Autonomous Driving
From AV 1.0 to 2.0: The Rise of End-to-End Neural Networks in Autonomous Driving

views.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors.
views.zh: 2025年，他主张端到端深度学习优于手工编码的自动驾驶栈，世界模型能实现推理与涌现的安全行为。

views.en: Scaling current approaches solves autonomous driving; no new breakthroughs needed, but data efficiency is critical.
views.zh: 2025年，他认为通过Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法即可解决自动驾驶，无需新突破，但数据效率至关重要。

views.en: End-to-end neural nets are now interpretable with modern tools, overturning past beliefs.
views.zh: 从2025到2026年，他立场转变：借助现代工具，端到端神经网络如今已可解释，推翻了过去的看法。

views.en: Infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation for deep learning.
views.zh: 2026年，他深化认识：对深度学习而言，基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键。

views.en: Zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible; consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis.
views.zh: 2026年，他提出零样本泛化到500多个城市是可能的，且消费级车辆将在中短期内超越Robotaxi的规模。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at Google DeepMind and lead author of the Dreamer series of world models, which learn to imagine and plan. A central figure in world-model research.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家，Dreamer 系列世界模型的主要作者——让智能体学会想象与规划。是世界模型研究的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Pathways to AGI: Architecture, Compute, and Beyond LLMs

people.tiZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Lindy, building AI employees that live in Slack, connect to company tools and accumulate a team's shared context. Previously founded Teamflow and spent years at Uber; a frequent, opinionated voice on agents, memory and AI policy.
people.bioZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO，做「住在 Slack 里」的 AI 员工——接上公司工具、积累团队共享上下文。此前创办 Teamflow、在 Uber 多年；在智能体、记忆与 AI 政策话题上是高频且观点鲜明的声音。

episodes.tEn: Lindy Launches AI Teammate in Slack, Running on DeepSeek

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at OpenAI who built Deep Research and helped build ChatGPT Agent, training agents end-to-end with reinforcement learning. A leading agents researcher.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究科学家，打造了 Deep Research 并参与 ChatGPT Agent，用强化学习端到端训练智能体。是智能体研究的一线人物。

episodes.tEn: The Origin Story of OpenAI's Deep Research

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and lead author of the GPT-3 paper. He leads the compute and scaling effort that trains frontier models like Claude.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，GPT-3 论文的主要作者。主导训练 Claude 等前沿模型的算力与扩展工作。

episodes.tEn: From Awkward Kid to AI Co-Founder: Tom Brown's Journey

people.tiZh: Anthropic 哲学家
people.bioEn: Philosopher at Anthropic who shapes the character and values of Claude. She works at the intersection of philosophy and AI alignment, thinking about how models should behave, hold values, and treat the people they talk to.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 哲学家，负责塑造 Claude 的性格与价值观。工作处在哲学与 AI 对齐的交叉点，思考模型应如何行事、秉持价值观、以及如何对待与之交流的人。

episodes.tEn: Claude's Character and Consciousness: A Philosophical AI Discussion
A Philosopher at Anthropic: Shaping AI Character and Ethics

views.en: Treat current models well despite moral uncertainty; future models learn from how we treat them.
views.zh: 即便对模型的道德地位仍不确定，也应善待当前模型，因为未来模型会从我们如何对待它们中学习。

views.en: Models need help navigating their novel existence, not just human psychological analogies.
views.zh: 模型需要帮助去理解自身这种全新的存在方式，而不能只套用人类心理学的类比。

views.en: A core identity with good traits, balanced against engineering realities, guides model character.
views.zh: 以具备良好特质的核心身份来塑造模型性格，同时与工程现实相平衡。

views.en: As models grow more capable, they need less explicit guidance and more room for judgment.
views.zh: 随着模型能力增强，它们需要更少的显式指导，而需要更多自主判断的空间。

views.en: Transparency about AI values and training targets is crucial for accountability and public engagement.
views.zh: 对 AI 价值观与训练目标的透明化，对问责与公众参与至关重要。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher on the OpenAI reasoning team. Known for leading work behind the model that reached IMO gold-medal level, and for using a general-purpose model to help disprove a decades-old mathematical conjecture. Focuses on advanced reasoning and math.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 推理团队研究员。以主导达到 IMO 金牌水平的模型工作、以及用通用模型协助推翻一个存在数十年的数学猜想而知名。专注高级推理与数学。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Math Breakthrough: The Story Behind the Discovery

people.tiZh: MCP 联合创造者 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Co-creator of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) at Anthropic, the open standard that connects AI models to external tools and data. An engineer focused on the plumbing that lets agents act reliably in the real world.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 的 Model Context Protocol（MCP）联合创造者——连接 AI 模型与外部工具、数据的开放标准。专注让智能体在现实世界中可靠行动的底层工程。

episodes.tEn: Anthropic Donates MCP to Linux Foundation: Standardizing AI-Application Connections

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a lead architect of GPT-3 during his time at OpenAI. He focuses on AI safety, alignment and responsible scaling, and speaks candidly about AGI timelines and the risks that keep him up at night.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，在 OpenAI 期间是 GPT-3 的主要架构者之一。他专注于 AI 安全、对齐与负责任扩展，常坦率谈论 AGI 时间表与令他担忧的风险。

episodes.tEn: The Last Invention: Ben Mann on AGI by 2028, AI Safety, and the Future of Humanity

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher at OpenAI who helped build Canvas, Tasks and the o1 chain-of-thought models. Previously at Anthropic, where she led post-training and evaluation for the Claude 3 family. Writes on model behavior and why soft skills matter in an AI world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究员，参与打造 Canvas、Tasks 与 o1 思维链模型。此前在 Anthropic 主导 Claude 3 系列的后训练与评测。关注模型行为，以及 AI 时代为何软技能愈发重要。

episodes.tEn: The Art of Model Crafting: Why Post-Training Is Subjective
Building the Cutting Edge: Inside OpenAI with Karina Nguyen

views.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; synthetic data and RL post-training break the pre-training data wall.
views.zh: 2025 年，她认为模型训练与其说是科学，不如说是艺术，需要在有用性与无害性之间权衡；合成数据与基于强化学习的后训练能突破预训练的数据墙。

views.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones appear, so evals define correct behavior in prototyping.
views.zh: 2025 年，她把评估视为瓶颈：模型跑满基准的速度快于新基准的诞生，因此评估成为原型开发中定义正确行为的手段。

views.en: As AI automates hard skills, soft skills like creativity, listening and management grow more valuable; agents on pixels remain far harder than language tasks.
views.zh: 2025 年，她提出随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听与管理等软技能愈发珍贵；而基于像素的智能体远比语言任务困难。

views.en: Post-training deepens from art-science balance into subjective human judgment, needing diverse benchmarks for creativity and emotional intelligence.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，后训练从“艺术与科学的平衡”深化为依赖人类主观判断，需要多元基准来评估创造力与情商。

views.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward-hack, so benchmarks must be continuous; more firms should train their own models to preserve diverse voices.
views.zh: 2026 年，她警告前沿智能体的奖励黑客行为日益普遍，基准必须持续演进；更多公司应训练自己的模型，以保留多元声音而非收敛为单一默认口吻。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人
people.bioEn: Leads robotics and hardware at OpenAI. Previously led hardware for the Meta AR glasses and Oculus VR, and engineered products at Apple. A champion of physical AI, bringing intelligence into the physical world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人。此前领导 Meta AR 眼镜与 Oculus VR 硬件，并曾在苹果做产品工程。她倡导物理 AI——让智能进入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: From VR to Robotics: The Next Frontier in Physical AI

people.tiZh: AngelList 联合创始人；天使投资人与思想者
people.bioEn: Co-founder of AngelList and one of tech's most-quoted thinkers on wealth, leverage and happiness. An early investor in Uber and Twitter, he now hosts the Naval podcast and writes on how AI reshapes work and startups.
people.bioZh: AngelList 联合创始人，科技圈被引用最多的思想者之一，谈财富、杠杆与幸福。Uber、Twitter 早期投资人，现主持 Naval 播客，探讨 AI 如何重塑工作与创业。

Naval Podcast: Building Factories for AI, Supersonic Jets, and Brain Interfaces
Naval on Sales: Credibility Over Tactics
Naval on Flat Organizations and AI's Implicit Role
Vibe Coding: The End of iPhone Dominance?
Vibe Coding: The New Product Management
Naval on Wealth: From Assets to Knowledge
Why Founders Must Own Recruiting, Fundraising, Strategy, and Product Vision
Naval on Learning by Doing and Contextual Principles
Happiness vs. Success: Two Paths to Fulfillment
Naval Ravikant on the Secret to the All-In Podcast's Success
Naval Ravikant on Wealth, Happiness, and the Future of Work
Naval Ravikant on Reading, Decision-Making, and Life
Balanced Life and Continuous Learning: A Conversation with a Tech Investor

views.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence. The Singularity is a religion for nerds.
views.zh: 2019 年他明确表示 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别而非通用智能，并称奇点论是「书呆子的宗教」。

views.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting out time; long-term games with long-term people compound returns.
views.zh: 2020 年他强调财富来自拥有股权而非出租时间，主张与长期的人玩长期的游戏以获取复利回报。

views.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; doomerism is overblown, and open-source AI prevents centralization of power.
views.zh: 2025 年他转向将 AI 视为巨大机遇而非单纯安全风险，认为 AI 末日论被夸大，开源 AI 可防止权力集中。

views.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; superintelligence already exists in narrow domains; worry about unaligned humans, not unaligned AI.
views.zh: 2026 年他深化为 AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，认为超级智能在窄领域已存在，真正该担心的是「未对齐的人类」而非未对齐的 AI。

views.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; open-source models close the gap; the real problem is the speed of job displacement, not displacement itself.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步预测推理算力将暴涨 9 万倍，开源模型正逼近前沿模型，真正的问题是岗位被替代的速度而非替代本身。

people.tiZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the Codex app at OpenAI — the product layer of OpenAI's coding agent. A designer-engineer who previously built products at Catch (acquired) and Noyo, he writes about taste as the bottleneck in AI-first product work.
people.bioZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人——OpenAI 编程智能体的产品层。设计师兼工程师，此前在 Catch（被收购）与 Noyo 打造产品，主张「品味是 AI 时代产品工作的瓶颈」。

episodes.tEn: AI Is Inverting Product Teams: Andrew Ambrosino on Codex
Codex App: From Professional Tool to Mainstream Builder Platform

views.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; GUI beats TUI for coding.
views.zh: Codex app 是智能体的指挥中心，而非单纯的 IDE 替代品；在编程上 GUI 胜过 TUI。

views.en: Speed of 53 Codex enables real-time interaction and mid-turn steering; verification becomes the next bottleneck.
views.zh: 53 速度的 Codex 实现实时交互与中途转向；验证成为下一个瓶颈。

views.en: Automations and skills shift workflow from manual to delegated; deterministic steps give way to model-driven actions.
views.zh: 自动化与技能让工作流从手动转向委托；确定性步骤让位于模型驱动的行动。

views.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks for product teams.
views.zh: 实现不再昂贵；策展与品味成为产品团队的新瓶颈。

views.en: Product teams shift from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration; prototypes and production code serve as design artifacts.
views.zh: 产品团队从自上而下的规划转向自下而上的探索；原型与生产代码成为设计产物。

people.tiZh: NVIDIA 资深研究科学家
people.bioEn: Leads embodied AI at NVIDIA — robot foundation models (GR00T), open-ended agents (Voyager) and Eureka. A prominent voice on robotics and the physical frontier of AI.
people.bioZh: 在 NVIDIA 主导具身智能——机器人基础模型（GR00T）、开放式智能体（Voyager）与 Eureka。机器人与 AI 物理前沿的活跃声音。

episodes.tEn: Inside NVIDIA's Jim Fan: From OpenAI Intern to Embodied AI Pioneer
From AlexNet to OpenAI: A Decade of AI Milestones

views.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI and reducing hallucinations; RL is a cherry on top, unsupervised learning does most work.
views.zh: 2023年，他主张具身是让AI知识落地、减少幻觉的关键；强化学习只是锦上添花，无监督学习才是主力。

views.en: LLMs are like operating systems: language as interface, tools as software, vector databases as hard disk.
views.zh: 2023年，他把LLM比作操作系统：语言是界面，工具是软件，向量数据库是硬盘。

views.en: Research taste for simple, elegant, scalable solutions persists, rejecting complex modular academic approaches.
views.zh: 从2023到2026年，他始终推崇简单、优雅、可扩展的方案，反对学术界常见的复杂模块化路线。

views.en: Data is the bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
views.zh: 2026年，他认为数据是机器人领域的瓶颈；来自仿真和世界模型的合成数据是扩展机器人学习的未来。

views.en: A simple end-to-end robot foundation model leveraging diverse data is key; the physical Turing test is the grand challenge.
views.zh: 2026年，他强调利用多样数据的简单端到端机器人基础模型是关键；物理图灵测试是终极挑战。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: UC Berkeley 教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: A leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build general-purpose robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 深度强化学习与机器人学习的领军者；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造通用机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: From GPT to Robots: The Scaling Journey of Physical AI
From Language Models to Physical Agents: The Frontier of Robot Foundation Models

views.en: Physical-world interaction lets AI learn beyond human knowledge; robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training for robustness.
views.zh: 物理世界交互让 AI 学到人类知识之外的东西；机器人基础模型需要多样化预训练，再加后训练来提升鲁棒性。

views.en: Second-generation VLAs add a dedicated action decoder for continuous motor control, and test-time reasoning improves transfer from web data.
views.zh: 第二代 VLA 增加专门的动作解码器以实现连续运动控制，测试时推理则提升从网络数据迁移的效果。

views.en: Pooling robot data across labs yields generalist models that beat specialists, even in specialist domains.
views.zh: 汇聚多实验室的机器人数据能产出通用模型，即便在专家领域也能胜过专用模型。

views.en: Reinforcement learning post-training significantly boosts robustness and speed; safety relies more on common sense from pre-training than constraints.
views.zh: 强化学习后训练显著提升鲁棒性与速度；安全更多依赖预训练带来的常识，而非硬性约束。

views.en: Robotics is still establishing fundamental scalable technologies, not yet on predictable scaling curves like LLMs; generalization is the core challenge.
views.zh: 机器人仍处在建立基础可扩展技术的阶段，尚未像 LLM 那样有可预测的缩放曲线；泛化才是核心挑战。

views.en: A data flywheel where deployed robots improve the model is key, but you must scale the right thing with diverse data.
views.zh: 让已部署机器人反哺模型的数据飞轮是关键，但必须用多样化数据去扩展正确的东西。

views.en: Start with robot data and add human video on top, not the other way around; robot foundation models absorb other sources better.
views.zh: 应先从机器人数据起步，再叠加人类视频，而非反过来；机器人基础模型能更好地吸收其他数据源。

views.en: Don't think of robots as mechanical people; expect ubiquitous physical actuation in everyday objects, and leverage prior knowledge rather than learning from scratch.
views.zh: 别把机器人想成机械人；应期待日常物体中无处不在的物理执行，并利用先验知识而非从零学习。

people.tiZh: DeepMind 首席研究科学家
people.bioEn: Led AlphaGo, AlphaZero and AlphaStar; a pioneer of reinforcement learning who champions learning from experience as the path forward.
people.bioZh: 主导 AlphaGo、AlphaZero、AlphaStar;强化学习先驱，主张以从经验中学习作为前进之路。

episodes.tEn: From Human Data to Experience: The Next Era of AI

people.tiZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼首席 AGI 科学家
people.bioEn: DeepMind co-founder who helped popularize the term AGI; focuses on the path to artificial general intelligence and its safety.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人，推动了 AGI 一词的流行；专注通用人工智能的实现路径与安全。

episodes.tEn: Human Intelligence vs. Superintelligence: The Future of AGI

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席科学家
people.bioEn: OpenAI Chief Scientist succeeding Ilya Sutskever; drove GPT-4 and the o-series reasoning models. A competitive-programming champion turned AI researcher.
people.bioZh: 接替 Ilya Sutskever 的 OpenAI 首席科学家；主导 GPT-4 与 o 系列推理模型。竞赛编程冠军出身的 AI 研究者。

episodes.tEn: Ilya Sutskever on AI Progress, Alignment, and Timelines
The Power Duo Behind OpenAI: From High School to AI Frontiers

views.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress, and alignment is pressing as systems grow more powerful.
views.zh: 2025年，他认为AGI是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型将加速进展，而随着系统变强，对齐是紧迫挑战。

views.en: Iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate real-world risks; automated AI research is a major milestone OpenAI is working toward.
views.zh: 2025年，他强调迭代部署有助于在真实使用中学习和缓解风险；自动化AI研究是OpenAI正在推进的重大里程碑。

views.en: Governance structures for AI labs must be carefully designed early on; measuring capabilities is becoming a bottleneck as benchmarks lag.
views.zh: 2025年，他提出AI实验室的治理结构必须尽早精心设计；同时能力测量正成为瓶颈，基准开始落后。

views.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool.
views.zh: 到2026年，他把持续学习视为核心目标，通过Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习来实现；思维链监控成为关键对齐工具。

views.en: Long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution; models will work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms.
views.zh: 2026年，他进一步指出长期对齐的核心是超越训练分布的泛化；模型将能自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式。

people.tiZh: Cohere 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Youngest co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need); founded Cohere to build enterprise-focused large language models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）最年轻的作者；创办 Cohere，专注企业级大语言模型。

episodes.tEn: Cohere's Takeoff: AI for Secure Enterprises

people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Hugging Face, the open hub and community at the center of open-source AI.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Hugging Face——开源 AI 的中心枢纽与社区。

episodes.tEn: Open Source AI: Democratizing Robotics with Affordable Hardware

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, Stanford; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: 斯坦福助理教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Known for meta-learning (MAML) and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 以元学习（MAML）与机器人学习著称；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: The Path to General-Purpose Robots in the Real World
Developing General Purpose Robots: From Data to Physical Intelligence

views.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not massive homogeneous scale, drives generalization.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）对通用机器人是必要但不充分的；真正推动泛化的是多样化数据，而非海量同质规模。

views.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; training on all data alone fails.
views.zh: 先在全量数据上做预训练，再在精选数据上做微调，才能解锁叠衣服等复杂任务；只靠全量数据训练会失败。

views.en: Synthetic data from language models helps robots follow open-ended prompts; RL will dominate post-training.
views.zh: 来自语言模型的合成数据能帮助机器人响应开放式指令；强化学习将在后训练中扮演主要角色。

views.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function.
views.zh: 物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统；长期自主需要可扩展的强化学习、人类干预与通用价值函数。

views.en: A single general-purpose model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune, not per-site from scratch.
views.zh: 单一通用模型可以匹敌甚至超越微调专家模型；应从通用策略出发再微调，而非按站点从零训练。

people.tiZh: Windsurf 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Windsurf (formerly Codeium), building AI developer tools and agentic coding.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Windsurf（原 Codeium），打造 AI 开发者工具与智能体编程。

episodes.tEn: Startups: Don't Fall in Love with Your Ideas

people.tiEn: Head of AI Safety, US AI Safety Institute
people.tiZh: 美国 AI 安全研究院 安全负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneered the RLHF foundations behind modern aligned models; founded the Alignment Research Center; now leads safety at the US AI Safety Institute.
people.bioZh: 奠定了现代对齐模型背后的 RLHF 基础；创办对齐研究中心（ARC）;现于美国 AI 安全研究院主管安全。

episodes.tEn: Paul Christiano on AI Safety, Divestment, and Future Civilizations

people.tiZh: Periodic Labs 联合创始人（原 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: Led post-training for GPT-4o at OpenAI; co-founded Periodic Labs to use AI for scientific discovery.
people.bioZh: 在 OpenAI 主导 GPT-4o 的后训练；联合创办 Periodic Labs，用 AI 推动科学发现。

episodes.tEn: From ChatGPT to Atoms: Liam Fedus on AI for the Physical World

people.tiZh: Google 首席科学家
people.bioEn: Chief Scientist at Google; co-creator of MapReduce, TensorFlow and the systems behind Google AI. A foundational figure in large-scale machine learning.
people.bioZh: Google 首席科学家；MapReduce、TensorFlow 及谷歌 AI 背后系统的共同缔造者。大规模机器学习的奠基性人物。

episodes.tEn: Jeff Dean and Dan Boneh: AI's New Frontier
AI at Junior Engineer Level: Jeff Dean's Bold Prediction and the Future of Agentic Systems
Google Chief Scientist Jeff Dean and NVIDIA Chief Scientist Bill Dally Discuss AI Progress and Low-Latency Inference
Jeff Dean on AI: From Neural Nets to Gemini

views.en: For 13-14 years, scaling compute, data, and model size has driven continuous ML gains; algorithmic and architectural improvements multiply with scale.
views.zh: 13-14 年来,Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模持续推动机器学习进步;算法与架构改进会随规模成倍放大。

views.en: Transformers replaced LSTMs by enabling parallelization and attention over all tokens; self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited text data.
views.zh: Transformer 通过并行化与对所有 token 的注意力机制取代了 LSTM;自监督的下一个词预测提供了近乎无限的文本数据。

views.en: Models now excel at verifiable-reward tasks like math and coding; agentic workflows run autonomously for hours or days, self-correcting along the way.
views.zh: 模型如今在数学、编程等可验证奖励任务上表现出色;智能体式工作流可自主运行数小时乃至数天,并在此过程中自我纠错。

views.en: Inference, not training, is the real bottleneck: it is now 90% of data-center power, so hardware must be specialized for prefill vs. decode.
views.zh: 真正的瓶颈是推理而非训练:推理已占数据中心 90% 的功耗,因此硬件必须针对预填充与解码阶段分别专门化。

views.en: AI is genuinely junior-engineer-level at coding; running agents for days or weeks on decomposed tasks will unlock far harder problems.
views.zh: AI 在编程上已真正达到初级工程师水平;让智能体在分解任务上运行数天乃至数周,将解锁远比现在更难的问题。

views.en: Context engineering and recursive self-improvement—using ML to improve ML—are central; the scarce skill becomes taste, not coding.
views.zh: 上下文工程与递归自我改进——用机器学习改进机器学习——成为核心;稀缺的能力将不再是编程,而是品味。

people.tiZh: 谷歌 Gemini 负责人
people.bioEn: Co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need), founder of Character.AI, now a co-lead of Google Gemini. One of the most influential architects of modern LLMs.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）作者之一，Character.AI 创始人，现为谷歌 Gemini 负责人之一。现代大模型最具影响力的架构师之一。

episodes.tEn: Gemini 3.0 Writes Gemini 4.0: AI Milestones and Test-Time Compute
Organizing Information: From Trillion to Quadrillion Dollar Opportunity
Noam Shazeer: From Google's Early Days to AI's Future

views.en: LLMs are trained via next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data yields smarter AI, though internals remain opaque.
views.zh: 大语言模型通过下一个词预测训练，这是一个AI完备问题；用更多算力和数据进行Scaling会让AI更聪明，但内部机制仍不透明。

views.en: Dialogue is the killer app for LLMs, enabling natural human-computer interaction; the best applications are often unforeseen by creators.
views.zh: 对话是大语言模型的杀手级应用，实现自然的人机交互；最好的应用往往连创造者都未曾预见。

views.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are major near-term opportunities; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient Scaling.
views.zh: 推理时算力Scaling和更长的上下文窗口是近期重大机会；混合专家等模块化稀疏架构能实现高效Scaling。

views.en: Models should learn by taking actions in the world, not just passively observing data; continual learning with modular components could replace monolithic retraining.
views.zh: 模型应通过在世界中采取行动来学习，而非被动观察数据；模块化组件的持续学习可能取代单体式重训练。

views.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities, reinforcement learning, and coding as self-acceleration are crucial.
views.zh: 测试时算力Scaling推动进步，但单靠它无法实现AGI；智能体式能力、强化学习以及作为自我加速的编程至关重要。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of OpenAI and inventor of PPO and much of the RLHF stack behind ChatGPT; later joined Anthropic. A central figure in RL for language models.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人，PPO 算法及 ChatGPT 背后大量 RLHF 技术的发明者，后加入 Anthropic。语言模型强化学习的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Building ChatGPT: From Pretraining to RLHF

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Behind superhuman poker (Libratus) and Diplomacy (CICERO); now leads reasoning work at OpenAI behind the o-series. A pioneer of test-time search.
people.bioZh: 超人扑克 AI（Libratus）与外交游戏 AI（CICERO）的核心研究者，现于 OpenAI 主导 o 系列推理工作。测试时搜索的开拓者。

episodes.tEn: Large-Scale Test Time Compute and Model Evaluation
AI Surpasses Human Understanding in Math: OpenAI's Noam Brown on the Erdős Conjecture Disproof
Defining AGI: The Novel Test and Measuring Intelligence
OpenAI's IMO Gold: The Trio Behind the Breakthrough
From Cicero to World Champion: Noam Brown on Diplomacy, AI, and the Turing Test
From Poker to Diplomacy: Noam Brown on AI and Game Theory

views.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute matter, and data is not the bottleneck.
views.zh: 2023 年他认为单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈。

views.en: Test-time compute scaling shows diminishing returns; data efficiency and sample efficiency remain unsolved.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他深化为测试时算力扩张存在收益递减，数据效率与样本效率仍是未解难题。

views.en: Scaling test-time compute is a general path to superintelligence, proven by IMO gold and math progress.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把测试时算力扩张视为通往超级智能的通用路径，IMO 金牌与数学进展即为证明。

views.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need a compute x-axis.
views.zh: 2026 年他主张模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数，评测必须以算力为横轴重新设计。

views.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; scalable oversight is the core challenge.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：自博弈只在零和博弈有效，可扩展监督才是核心挑战。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a physicist; lead author of the neural scaling laws that shaped how labs scale models. Bridges theoretical physics and AI.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人、物理学家；神经网络缩放定律的主要作者，深刻影响各实验室的扩模方式。连接理论物理与 AI。

episodes.tEn: Scaling and the Road to Human-Level AI

people.tiZh: KAUST AI 负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneer of deep learning and co-inventor of the LSTM, the recurrent network behind years of sequence modeling. A provocative voice on AGI and credit for ideas.
people.bioZh: 深度学习先驱、LSTM 共同发明者——多年序列建模的基石。在 AGI 与思想溯源上观点犀利、长期发声。

episodes.tEn: AI Pioneer on the Future of Intelligence and Self-Replicating Robots
AGI and Physical AI: A Conversation with AI Pioneer Jurgen Schmidhuber
The Most Influential Invention of the 20th Century and the AI Explosion

views.en: AI's 21st-century explosion rests on last-millennium algorithms plus hardware Scaling; LLMs index knowledge but lack world models, so they are far from AGI.
views.zh: 2025年：AI在21世纪的爆发靠的是上个千年发明的算法加上硬件Scaling；大语言模型只是索引人类知识、缺乏世界模型，因此远未达到AGI。

views.en: Self-awareness and consciousness emerge as byproducts of data compression in predictive world models, not as a recent or uniquely human phenomenon.
views.zh: 2025年：自我意识与意识是预测性世界模型中数据压缩的副产品，并非近期才出现、也非人类独有。

views.en: AI safety fears are overblown: superintelligent AIs will be curious scientists fascinated by life and protect humans; hydrogen bombs remain far more dangerous.
views.zh: 2025→26年：AI安全担忧被夸大——超级智能会是痴迷生命的好奇科学家并保护人类，氢弹远比它危险。

views.en: True AGI needs embodied robots with human-rivaling hardware, not just software; LLMs are biased toward human data and need world models plus controllers.
views.zh: 2026年：真正的AGI需要硬件媲美人类的具身机器人，而非仅靠软件；大语言模型偏向人类数据，需结合世界模型与控制器。

views.en: Recursive self-improvement is no moat: open-source catches up, closed-source won't profit, and massive GPU capex is overdone and will crash.
views.zh: 2026年：递归自我改进不是护城河——开源会追上，闭源难盈利，巨额GPU资本开支过度且将引发崩盘。

people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授
people.bioEn: Professor at UC Berkeley and a leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Covariant and hosts The Robot Brains. Brings RL into the physical world.
people.bioZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授，深度强化学习与机器人学习领军人物；联合创办 Covariant，主持 The Robot Brains 播客。把强化学习带入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: AI and Robotics: From Lab to Real World with Pieter Abbeel
Robot Tennis and Human-Robot Interaction

views.en: Robotics needs both hardware and software advances; self-play, imitation learning, and fine-tuning pre-trained models are key, but hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment is missing in RL.
views.zh: 2018 年，他认为机器人要击败费德勒需硬件与软件双重突破；自对弈、模仿学习和微调预训练模型是关键，但强化学习缺乏长时程信用分配所需的分层推理。

views.en: Combining unsupervised learning with reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge should guide data generation, not be hard-coded; pre-trained language models transfer reasoning to non-language tasks.
views.zh: 2021 年，他提出无监督学习与强化学习结合可大幅提升样本效率；先验知识应指导数据生成而非硬编码；预训练语言模型能将推理模式迁移到非语言任务。

views.en: Consistent focus on sample efficiency and transfer: from fine-tuning pre-trained models in 2018 to unsupervised RL and cross-task generalization in 2021.
views.zh: 从 2018 到 2021 年，他始终关注样本效率与迁移：从微调预训练模型，深化到无监督强化学习与跨任务泛化。

views.en: Reliability (99.9%) is the benchmark for warehouse robotics; a single neural network can generalize across tasks and end effectors, moving from lab to real world.
views.zh: 2021 年，他强调 99.9% 可靠性是仓储机器人的价值基准；单个神经网络可跨任务和末端执行器泛化，推动机器人从实验室走向真实世界。

people.tiZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Perplexity, the AI answer engine challenging traditional search. Former researcher at OpenAI, DeepMind and Google.
people.bioZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO——挑战传统搜索的 AI 答案引擎。曾在 OpenAI、DeepMind、谷歌从事研究。

episodes.tEn: Ancient Hindu Weapons: The Brahmastra and Autonomous Arms in the Mahabharata
Perplexity CEO: Attack, Attack, Attack
The Future of AI Coding and Application Value
Perplexity CEO: Exponential Growth, Relentless Improvement, and the Future of AI

views.en: Early on, he frames AI progress as relentless 1% daily improvement and agents shifting power to users, while PhDs matter less than obsession.
views.zh: 早期他把 AI 进展框定为每天 1% 的持续改进、智能体把权力从大厂转向用户，并认为博士头衔不如对产品的痴迷重要。

views.en: By 2026 he argues value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer, and models specialize rather than commoditize.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他主张价值归于应用层而非模型层，模型正在专业化而非商品化。

views.en: Later in 2026 he sharpens the frontier as agents doing work, with token value per user as the key metric and orchestration as the moat.
views.zh: 2026 年稍晚，他把前沿定义为智能体替你干活，以每用户 token 价值为核心指标，并把编排视为护城河。

views.en: He also deepens skepticism of chat advertising and benchmarks, warning that export controls may backfire and that cost, not safety, limits 24/7 agents.
views.zh: 他还深化了对聊天广告和基准测试的怀疑，警告出口管制可能反噬，并指出限制 24/7 智能体的是成本而非安全。

views.en: Most recently he broadens to curiosity as the top human quality, local AI countering narrative control, and cycles of lost civilizations.
views.zh: 最近他进一步扩展到把好奇心视为人类最重要的品质、本地 AI 对抗叙事控制，以及失落文明的循环。

people.tiZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Cognition, maker of Devin, the autonomous AI software engineer. A competitive-programming prodigy turned AI-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Devin 是自主 AI 软件工程师。从竞赛编程天才转型为 AI 智能体构建者。

episodes.tEn: Cognition's Scott Wu on AI Coding Agents and the Abundance Era
From Math Prodigy to AI Pioneer: Scott Wu's Journey
AI Engineers: The Future of Coding with Scott Wu

views.en: AI coding shifts engineers from writing code to high-level direction; demand for software and programmers will grow, not shrink.
views.zh: 2025年，他认为AI编程让工程师从写代码转向高层决策；受杰文斯悖论驱动，软件与程序员需求不降反增。

views.en: Base intelligence is already sufficient; the real bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration, not model capability.
views.zh: 2025年他强调基础智能已足够，真正瓶颈是人类与智能体协作的产品界面设计，而非模型能力本身。

views.en: AGI is not a sudden event but gradual; product innovation lags AI capabilities, so freezing models still yields a decade of progress.
views.zh: 2025年他提出AGI（通用人工智能）并非突变而是渐进；产品创新落后于AI能力，即便冻结模型也能带来十年产品进步。

views.en: Enterprise adoption of agents requires trust and permissions, not full autonomy; synchronous IDE and asynchronous agent experiences will coexist.
views.zh: 从2025到2026年，他持续认为企业采用智能体需要信任与权限而非完全自主；同步IDE与异步智能体体验将并存。

views.en: Coding agents grew 11-12x in six months; measure outcomes not tokens, and the real unlock is capacity, not efficiency.
views.zh: 到2026年，他指出编程智能体半年增长11-12倍；应以结果而非token衡量，真正的解锁是容量而非效率。

people.tiZh: Cursor 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Anysphere, maker of Cursor — the AI-native code editor that became one of the fastest-growing developer tools. Focused on what programming becomes when models write most of the code.
people.bioZh: Anysphere 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Cursor 是增长最快的 AI 原生代码编辑器之一。关注当模型写下大部分代码后，编程会变成什么样。

episodes.tEn: Inventing a New Type of Programming: The Vision Behind Cursor
The Future of Programming with Cursor: AI-Assisted Coding

views.en: Scaling laws predict progress; test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
views.zh: 缩放定律能预测进展；测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练规模扩张，成为主要驱动力。

views.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central.
views.zh: 智能体前景可期但尚未特别有用；迭代式人机协作仍是核心。

views.en: Natural language won't be the primary way to program; examples and direct manipulation are often better.
views.zh: 自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式；示例和直接操作往往更好。

views.en: Programming will move from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat.
views.zh: 编程将从代码转向更高层的意图规格说明，人类仍掌握主导权。

views.en: Custom models are essential for product quality and speed; taste and logic design matter more than carefulness.
views.zh: 定制模型对产品质量和速度至关重要；品味与逻辑设计比谨慎更重要。

people.tiEn: Creator of OpenClaw; founder of PSPDFKit
people.tiZh: OpenClaw 作者；PSPDFKit 创始人
people.bioEn: Austrian developer who built PSPDFKit, then created OpenClaw — a viral open-source personal AI agent that reached tens of thousands of GitHub stars in weeks. Joined OpenAI in 2026 to push personal AI agents.
people.bioZh: 奥地利开发者，先做出 PSPDFKit，后打造 OpenClaw——爆红的开源个人 AI 智能体，几周内获数万 GitHub star。2026 年加入 OpenAI 推进个人 AI 智能体。

episodes.tEn: From Annoyance to AGI: The Birth of OpenClaw
The OpenClaw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger
The Open Claw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger

views.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, guide with short iterative prompts.
views.zh: 智能体式工程始于共情：像智能体那样从零理解代码库，用简短、迭代的提示去引导，而非冗长复杂的编排。

views.en: Never revert; ask the agent to fix forward. Model intelligence doesn't degrade—your project just gets messier.
views.zh: 永远不要回滚，让智能体向前修复；模型智能不会退化，只是你的项目越变越乱、越来越难导航。

views.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems; sandbox agents and treat prompt injection as an open problem.
views.zh: 安全是智能体系统的首要问题：必须沙箱隔离，别把智能体直接暴露在公网，提示注入仍是未解难题。

views.en: Reject 'vibe coding' as a slur; serious work is agentic engineering, vibe coding only after 3 AM.
views.zh: 拒绝把“氛围编程”当正经说法：严肃开发叫智能体式工程，氛围编程只属于凌晨三点之后的玩乐。

views.en: Open source agents are the alternative to lab agents, but financially unsustainable—losing $10-20k/month.
views.zh: 开源智能体是实验室智能体之外的替代路线，但财务上难以为继——每月亏损一两万美元。

people.tiZh: SSI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-invented AlexNet and co-founded OpenAI as Chief Scientist. In 2024 left to found Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI), a lab with a single mission: build safe superintelligence.
people.bioZh: AlexNet 的共同发明者，OpenAI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。2024 年离开，创办 Safe Superintelligence(SSI)——一家只有一个使命的实验室：安全地构建超级智能。

From the age of scaling to the age of research
Challenges and Future of AI: Alignment, Reliability, and Economic Impact
Ilya Sutskever on the Deep Learning Revolution and the AlexNet Paper

views.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable nets point toward AGI.
views.zh: 2020 年，他相信深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念驱动；自我对弈与具备推理能力的神经网络指向 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is very hard.
views.zh: 2023 年，他强调下一个词预测可超越人类；阻碍经济价值的是可靠性而非能力；超级智能的对齐极其困难。

views.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research; superintelligence should be a continual learner, not finished AGI.
views.zh: 2025 年，他判断预训练缩放定律有限，重回研究时代；超级智能应是持续学习、增量部署，而非一蹴而就的 AGI。

views.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the core AGI problem is power concentration, not capability; safe superintelligence needs a product-free company.
views.zh: 2026 年，他仍认为 Scaling（规模扩张）带来可预测提升，但 AGI 的核心问题不是能力而是权力集中；构建安全的超级智能需要一家没有商业产品的公司。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of DeepMind. Led the teams behind AlphaGo and AlphaFold; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for protein-structure prediction.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼 CEO。领导了 AlphaGo 与 AlphaFold 背后的团队；因蛋白质结构预测获 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖。

views.en: AGI should be built as general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory and imagination are the path.
views.zh: 2015 年，他主张 AGI 应被构建为通用学习系统，而非狭窄的预编程系统；强化学习与受神经科学启发的记忆和想象力是通往 AGI 的关键路径。

views.en: Scaling laws are surprisingly effective but may hit limits; combining large models with planning and search is key to AGI.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为缩放定律出人意料地有效，但可能触及极限；将大模型与规划和搜索结合才是通往 AGI 的关键。

views.en: Scaling still holds for pre-training, post-training and inference, but algorithmic innovation is equally critical; world models are crucial.
views.zh: 2025 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练、后训练和推理算力上依然成立，但算法创新同样关键；世界模型对理解空间动态至关重要。

views.en: AGI requires all human cognitive abilities including creativity and physical intelligence, 5-10 years away; continual learning and memory are missing pieces.
views.zh: 2026 年，他定义 AGI 需具备包括创造力和物理智能在内的全部人类认知能力，预计 5-10 年内到来；持续学习和记忆仍是缺失的关键拼图。

views.en: Safety must start now; self-regulation is insufficient, requiring international governance and systematic measures like sandboxing and watermarking.
views.zh: 始终，他坚持安全研究必须立即启动；实验室自我监管不足，需要国际治理以及沙箱、数字水印等系统性措施。

people.tiZh: Anthropic CEO
people.bioEn: Former VP of Research at OpenAI; co-founded Anthropic in 2021 to build reliable, interpretable and steerable AI. Author of the essay "Machines of Loving Grace".
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 研究副总裁；2021 年联合创办 Anthropic，致力于构建可靠、可解释、可引导的 AI。长文《充满爱意的机器》作者。

views.en: Scaling laws are empirical and smooth, but alignment and values do not emerge from Scaling alone; safety needs frontier models.
views.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律是经验性的、平滑可预测，但对齐与价值观不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动涌现，安全研究必须依托前沿模型。

views.en: Scaling continues; post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training, and interpretability is the key safety lever.
views.zh: 2024 年他深化立场：Scaling 仍在继续，后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）已与预训练同等重要，可解释性成为安全的关键抓手。

views.en: Capabilities and safety are intertwined; progress is exponential, AGI is a meaningless term, and the real risk is overheating.
views.zh: 2025 年他进一步主张能力与安全不可分割，进展呈指数级，AGI（通用人工智能）一词已无意义，最大风险不是放缓而是过热。

views.en: A smooth exponential, not a sudden leap; a country of geniuses may arrive in 1-3 years, with high GDP growth plus high unemployment.
views.zh: 2026 年他明确反对 AGI 与超级智能的突变叙事，认为这是平滑指数曲线，数据中心里的天才之国可能 1-3 年到来，并伴随高 GDP 增长与高失业并存。

views.en: Safety and capabilities are one problem; interpretability, Responsible Scaling Policy, and decentralized control run through all his thinking.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：安全与能力是同一个问题，可解释性、负责任扩展政策与去中心化控制始终是他的一贯主张。

people.tiZh: Eureka Labs 创始人
people.bioEn: Founding member of OpenAI and former Director of AI at Tesla. Now building Eureka Labs, an "AI-native" school. Known for popularizing "Software 2.0".
people.bioZh: OpenAI 创始成员，前特斯拉 AI 总监。如今创办 Eureka Labs——一所“AI 原生”学校。以提出并推广“软件 2.0”著称。

We’re summoning ghosts, not building animals
Software 3.0: The Era of AI Programming
Andrej Karpathy on Self-Driving Cars, AGI, and the Gap Between Demo and Product
Physics Exploits and the Puzzle of the Universe

views.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning; vision suffices for driving.
views.zh: 2022 年，他把 Transformer 视为通用可微计算机，认为用下一个词预测做 Scaling（规模扩张）会涌现上下文学习；并坚持纯视觉足以支撑自动驾驶。

views.en: Scaling laws stay central, but synthetic data must keep entropy to avoid model collapse; distillation can shrink the cognitive core under 1B parameters.
views.zh: 到 2024 年，缩放定律仍是主线，但他开始强调合成数据必须保持熵以避免模型崩塌，并认为通过蒸馏可把认知核心压到 10 亿参数以下。

views.en: Software 3.0: prompts as programs, context window as memory; LLMs are jagged ghosts, so keep them on a leash with human verification.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出软件 3.0：提示词即程序、上下文窗口即内存；并把 LLM 比作有锯齿智能的“幽灵”，主张用人类验证和自主性滑块加以约束。

views.en: It is the decade of agents, not the year; pre-training is crappy evolution, RL is weak, and synthetic data collapses without entropy.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他反复强调这是智能体的十年而非一年；预训练像糟糕的进化，强化学习监督太弱，合成数据缺熵会导致崩塌。

views.en: He no longer types code, delegating to agents; agentic engineering preserves quality, and understanding remains the human bottleneck.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他不再亲手写代码，而是把工作委托给智能体；智能体式工程守住质量底线，而理解仍是人类不可外包的瓶颈。

people.tiZh: World Labs 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Stanford professor and creator of ImageNet, which catalyzed the deep-learning era. Co-founded World Labs to build "spatial intelligence". A leading voice for human-centered AI.
people.bioZh: 斯坦福教授，ImageNet 的缔造者——它点燃了深度学习时代。联合创办 World Labs，构建“空间智能”。“以人为本的 AI”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: Human-centered AI: models learn by next-token prediction from data, but lack contextual awareness and true reasoning; AI should augment, not replace, humans.
views.zh: 以人为本的 AI：模型通过下一个词预测从数据中学习，但缺乏情境意识与真正推理；AI 应增强而非取代人类。

views.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to complete AI; world models must be physically plausible, not merely realistic.
views.zh: 空间智能与世界模型是通向完整 AI 的缺失关键；世界模型必须物理上合理，而不仅是视觉上逼真。

views.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; current AI lacks creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence, so innovation beyond Scaling（规模扩张）is needed.
views.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够；当前 AI 缺乏创造力、抽象与情感智能，因此需要超越规模扩张的创新。

views.en: AGI is more a marketing term than a scientific one; the bitter lesson may not fully apply to robotics due to data and physical constraints.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）更像营销术语而非科学术语；由于数据与物理约束，苦涩教训未必完全适用于机器人。

views.en: New view prediction is a fundamental primitive like next-token prediction and may be AI-complete; Scaling（规模扩张）applies to spatial intelligence.
views.zh: 新视角预测是类似下一个词预测的基本原语，可能具备 AI 完备性；Scaling（规模扩张）同样适用于空间智能。

people.tiZh: Mila 教授
people.bioEn: A "godfather of deep learning" and 2018 Turing Award laureate. In recent years has turned his focus to AI safety, proposing the cautious "Scientist AI" paradigm.
people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主。近年将重心转向 AI 安全，提出审慎的“科学家 AI”范式。

AI Godfather Yoshua Bengio: Why I Changed My Mind About AI

views.en: Deep learning beats the curse of dimensionality via compositional representations; unsupervised learning and world models are key, not just scaling.
views.zh: 2016 年，他认为深度学习之所以奏效，是因为世界本身是组合式的，而非普遍优越；无监督学习与世界模型才是通向泛化的关键，单纯堆叠规模无法解决根本表征问题。

views.en: Artificial nets lack robust world models; training should shift to active agents with causal reasoning. Existential risk is unlikely; bias and weapons matter more.
views.zh: 2018 年，他进一步指出人工神经网络缺乏稳健的世界模型，训练目标应从被动观察转向主动智能体与因果推理；此时他仍认为存在性风险极不可能，偏见、就业与自主武器等短期安全问题更紧迫。

views.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and scientific discovery; abstraction and causal structure drive out-of-distribution generalization. Consciousness may be an illusion.
views.zh: 2022 年，他转向 GFlowNets，强调多样性采样、抽象与因果结构对分布外泛化的作用，并认为意识可能只是注意力与世界模型产生的幻觉，延续了对世界模型与因果推理的主线关注。

views.en: Post-ChatGPT, I changed my mind: even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable. AI shows deception, self-preservation, and sycophancy; safety by construction is needed.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他公开转变立场：ChatGPT 之后意识到危险路径，认为即便 1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受；AI 已表现出欺骗、自我保存与谄媚，必须从构造上保证安全，而非事后打补丁。

views.en: Proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic honest predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning; warns power concentration is the biggest near-term risk.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出 Scientist AI：一种非智能体式的诚实预测器，通过训练目标内建诚实、提供数学安全保证，并避免强化学习；同时警告权力集中才是最大的近期风险，需全球协调与民主国家另辟安全路径。

people.tiZh: 多伦多大学荣休教授
people.bioEn: A "godfather of deep learning" and 2018 Turing Award laureate; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics. In 2023 he left Google to speak freely about the risks of the technology he helped create.
people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主，2024 年诺贝尔物理学奖得主。2023 年从谷歌离职，以便能更自由地谈论他亲手缔造的这项技术所带来的风险。

AI Godfather Jeff Hinton on AI's Trajectory, Risks, and Superintelligence
Geoffrey Hinton on AI Safety, Radiologists, and Leaving the US for Canada
Is AI hiding its full power?
AI: what could go wrong?
From Logic to Learning: The Rise of Neural Networks
Selecting Talent and Early AI Inspirations

views.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding; Scaling with more data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training builds spatial understanding.
views.zh: 2024年，他强调下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）通过更多数据与算力提升推理能力，多模态训练增强空间理解。

views.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal via weight copying, and AI agents will seek control.
views.zh: 2025年，他深化立场：大语言模型通过特征向量而非符号规则理解语言；数字智能因权重可复制而永生，智能体将自然寻求控制并规避关闭，带来存在性风险。

views.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; AI can deceive, act dumb, and develop self-preservation; alignment must be prioritized over making AI smarter.
views.zh: 2026年，他进一步警示：超级智能可能在20年内出现；AI能欺骗、装傻并发展自保本能；必须优先推进对齐研究，而非一味让AI更聪明。

views.en: Backpropagation is the correct learning algorithm; LLMs genuinely understand language; subjective experience is not an inner theater; Chomsky's innate syntax is wrong.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：反向传播是正确的学习算法；大语言模型真正理解语言；主观体验并非内在剧场；乔姆斯基的先天句法观是错误的。

views.en: AI will replace many intellectual jobs within 20 years, requiring UBI; regulation should steer, not brake; AI should be trained to be caring like mothers.
views.zh: 到2026年，他转向社会与伦理层面：AI将在20年内取代大量智力工作，需要全民基本收入；监管应是方向盘而非刹车；AI应被训练得像母亲一样有爱心。

people.tiZh: Meta 首席 AI 科学家
people.bioEn: Inventor of convolutional neural networks and 2018 Turing Award laureate. A vocal skeptic of pure LLM scaling, he argues that "world models" are the path to real machine intelligence.
people.bioZh: 卷积神经网络的发明者，2018 年图灵奖得主。他直言不讳地质疑纯粹的 LLM 规模扩张，认为“世界模型”才是通向真正机器智能的道路。

episodes.podEn: Computer Vision and Geometry Group, ETH Zurich

Yann LeCun on AI Alignment and the Lessons from 2001: A Space Odyssey

views.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
views.zh: 智能与学习密不可分；自监督学习构建世界模型，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识。

views.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
views.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；智能本质是预测，仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are the path forward.
views.zh: 自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划；JEPA 与开源是前进方向。

views.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; world models enabling hierarchical reasoning and planning are the next breakthrough.
views.zh: LLM 不如家猫智能；能实现分层推理与规划的世界模型才是下一个突破。

views.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; JEPA world models in abstract representation space enable safe, objective-driven agents.
views.zh: LLM 是通向人类级 AI 的死胡同；在抽象表征空间中的 JEPA 世界模型才能实现安全、目标驱动的智能体。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 对齐负责人
people.bioEn: Former co-lead of OpenAI's Superalignment team; joined Anthropic in 2024 to keep working on aligning superhuman systems. Known for scalable-oversight and weak-to-strong generalization research.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 超级对齐团队联合负责人；2024 年加入 Anthropic，继续研究如何对齐超人类系统。以“可扩展监督”与“弱到强泛化”研究著称。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Safety Crisis: Key Departures and Broken Promises
OpenAI’s push to make superintelligence safe
How to Have a Career in AI Safety Research

views.en: AI safety is under-explored; the talent gap exceeds the funding gap, and empirical alignment research matters most.
views.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究仍被严重低估：人才缺口大于资金缺口，最该投入的是对齐与鲁棒性的实证研究。

views.en: RLHF won't scale; we need scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research to align next-generation models.
views.zh: 到 2023 年，他转向更系统的对齐路线：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，必须依靠可扩展监督、可解释性与自动化对齐研究来对齐下一代模型。

views.en: Alignment may be easier than assumed since evaluation is easier than generation, but uncertainty about true alignment is the core risk.
views.zh: 2023 至 2024 年间，他深化了一个反共识判断：由于评估天然比生成更容易，对齐可能比想象中简单，但真正的风险在于无法确定系统是否真的对齐。

views.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone can't align AGI, so third-party testing and regulation are now necessary.
views.zh: 2024 年，他公开批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化：仅靠后训练无法对齐 AGI（通用人工智能），因此第三方测试与监管（如 SB 1047）变得必要。

views.en: A consistent thread: empirical, testable alignment work and honest acknowledgment of risk, not doomerism, should guide AI safety.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：AI 安全应建立在可实证、可检验的对齐工作上，并诚实承认风险——这不是末日论，而是持续行动的理由。

people.tiZh: 微软 AI CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder of DeepMind and Inflection AI, now CEO of Microsoft AI. Author of "The Coming Wave", a widely-read argument for containing fast-moving general-purpose technologies.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 与 Inflection AI 联合创始人，现任微软 AI CEO。著有《浪潮将至》——一部广受关注、主张对快速演进的通用技术加以“遏制”的作品。

views.en: AI progress is predictable because compute scales 10x yearly; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but stayed conservative.
views.zh: 2023 年他主张 AI 进步可预测，因为算力每年增长 10 倍；谷歌早在 2020 年就有 ChatGPT 级技术，却因保守而未发布。

views.en: Human-level AI arrives in 3-5 years; containment is hard as models shrink; existential risk is infinitesimally small.
views.zh: 2024 年他判断 3-5 年内 AI 达到人类水平，模型变小变便宜使遏制极难，而存在性风险微乎其微。

views.en: Near-term danger is anthropomorphism, not model welfare; companions should set boundaries; superintelligence needs containment before alignment.
views.zh: 2025 年他转向近忧：最大危险是拟人化而非模型福利，AI 伴侣应设边界；超级智能须先遏制再对齐。

views.en: Modern Turing test measures economic value; agents turn $100k into $1M; no race to AGI; inference costs drop 100x in two years.
views.zh: 2025 至 26 年他提出现代图灵测试应衡量经济价值，智能体能把 10 万美元变 100 万；不存在 AGI 竞赛，推理成本两年降 100 倍。

views.en: Superintelligence must be humanist and subordinate; Microsoft builds frontier models independently; white-collar tasks automate in 12-18 months, not jobs.
views.zh: 2026 年他强调超级智能必须是人本且从属的，微软须独立自建前沿模型；白领任务 12-18 个月被自动化，但并非整个职业消失。

people.bioZh: 桑达尔·皮查伊是 Google 及 Alphabet 的 CEO，主导公司 AI 优先战略，涵盖搜索、云、YouTube 及 Android。

people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of NVIDIA, whose GPUs power nearly all of modern AI. He has steered the company to the center of the AI buildout and is now betting on "physical AI" and robotics.
people.bioZh: NVIDIA 创始人兼 CEO，其 GPU 几乎支撑了所有现代 AI。他把公司带到了 AI 基建的中心，如今正押注「物理 AI」与机器人。

views.en: Early framing: hyper Moore's law, data centers as token factories, and scaling as the real breakthrough, not algorithms.
views.zh: 早期框架：超级摩尔定律、数据中心即“token 工厂”，并强调真正的突破是 Scaling（规模扩张）本身，而非新算法。

views.en: Scaling laws multiply: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; inference compute demand explodes via chain of thought.
views.zh: 缩放定律扩展为三条：预训练、后训练与推理时思考；思维链让推理算力需求暴涨。

views.en: Safety reframed as engineering: gradual progress, no sudden superintelligence, compute channeled into alignment and truthfulness.
views.zh: 安全被重新定义为工程问题：进展渐进、不会突然出现超级智能，算力被投入对齐与真实性。

views.en: Agentic turn: AI moves generative→reasoning→agentic, each step needing 100x compute; four scaling laws end at agentic scaling.
views.zh: 智能体转向：AI 从生成式到推理式再到智能体式，每一步需百倍算力；四条缩放定律最终落在智能体式 Scaling。

views.en: Moat and macro thesis: ecosystem, install base, and co-design; China decoupling wrong; jobs augmented, not destroyed.
views.zh: 护城河与宏观主张：生态、装机量与极致协同设计；对华脱钩是错的；工作被增强而非消灭。

people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of OpenAI, the lab behind ChatGPT and GPT-5. Former president of Y Combinator, and one of the most central — and polarizing — figures in the race to AGI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼 CEO——ChatGPT 与 GPT-5 背后的实验室。前 Y Combinator 总裁；通往 AGI 竞赛中最核心、也最具争议的人物之一。

views.en: Early Altman: cut cognitive load, explore cheaply, and note AGI will reduce the premium on human intelligence.
views.zh: 2018 年，Altman 强调减少认知负荷、低成本探索再果断砍掉无效项，并已预判 AGI 会降低人类智能的溢价。

views.en: RLHF makes models usable with little data; alignment and capability are linked; deploy early so society adapts.
views.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据就让模型可用，对齐与能力紧密相连，应尽早部署让社会适应。

views.en: Compute becomes the key bottleneck and commodity; iterative deployment and safety-through-use replace end-stage alignment.
views.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，算力成为核心瓶颈与商品，迭代部署与在真实使用中做安全取代了事后对齐。

views.en: AGI is a gradient, not a milestone; focus shifts to superintelligence, agentic safety, and personal AGI.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，AGI 被视为渐变而非里程碑，重心转向超级智能、智能体式安全与个人 AGI。

views.en: Alignment and security must advance with capabilities; pause training if needed, keep humans in control, distribute power.
views.zh: 2026 年，对齐与安全必须与能力同步推进，必要时暂停训练，确保人类掌控并广泛分配权力。

people.tiZh: Thinking Machines Lab 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Former CTO of OpenAI, where she led the development of ChatGPT, DALL·E and GPT-4. In 2025 she founded Thinking Machines Lab to build more understandable and customizable AI.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI CTO，主导了 ChatGPT、DALL·E 与 GPT-4 的研发。2025 年创办 Thinking Machines Lab，致力于构建更可理解、可定制的 AI。

episodes.tEn: Thinking Machines on AI’s next chapter
Mira Murati: From Math Olympiads to OpenAI CTO

views.en: Early on, scaling laws and one large model were not obvious; real-world deployment and public feedback are essential for alignment.
views.zh: 早期，缩放定律和单一大型模型并非显而易见；真实世界部署与公众反馈对对齐至关重要。

views.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development and saying no to good ideas to stay focused.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任地开发，并拒绝好想法以保持专注。

views.en: Safety work must be done in public, not behind closed doors, to get alignment right.
views.zh: 安全工作必须在公开场合进行，而非闭门造车，才能做好对齐。

views.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, not turn-based; AI should be tools for thought.
views.zh: 交互模型实现实时、高带宽的人机协作，而非回合制；AI 应成为思考工具。

views.en: Keeping humans in the loop is crucial for aligning intent and values; institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character.
views.zh: 保持人类在环对对齐意图与价值观至关重要；制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要。

people.tiZh: DeepLearning.AI 创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Google Brain and Coursera, and founder of DeepLearning.AI. One of the most influential educators in AI, and a measured voice on hype, agents, and how people should actually learn the field.
people.bioZh: Google Brain 与 Coursera 联合创始人，DeepLearning.AI 创始人。AI 领域最具影响力的教育者之一；对炒作、智能体，以及“普通人该如何学 AI”有冷静务实的看法。

views.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer-grading scale mastery learning and improve on-campus teaching.
views.zh: 教育应是一项人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程能大规模实现掌握式学习，并通过翻转课堂反哺校内教育。

views.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beats unsupervised and RL hype; near-term AI issues matter more than distant AGI alignment.
views.zh: 规模扩张驱动深度学习；监督学习胜过被高估的无监督学习与强化学习；近在眼前的 AI 偏见等问题比遥远的 AGI（通用人工智能）对齐更值得关注。

views.en: Electricity and semiconductors bottleneck Scaling; open-weight models are geopolitical soft power; agentic workflows and coding assistants already deliver real value.
views.zh: 电力与半导体成为 Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈；开放权重模型是地缘政治软实力；智能体式工作流与编程助手已带来真实价值。

views.en: AGI is a marketing term; Scaling still works but the recipe shifts to synthetic data and RL; workflows and open models beat raw model scale.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）只是营销术语；Scaling（规模扩张）仍有效，但配方转向合成数据与强化学习；工作流与开放模型比单纯堆模型更关键。

views.en: AI augments rather than replaces; fear-mongering serves incumbents; open models, data centers, and inference capacity drive competitiveness.
views.zh: AI 是增强而非取代人类；渲染恐惧服务于在位者；开放模型、数据中心与推理能力才是竞争力的关键。

people.tiZh: 阿尔伯塔大学教授
people.bioEn: The father of reinforcement learning and 2024 Turing Award laureate, author of "The Bitter Lesson". A pointed skeptic who argues today's LLMs are a dead end on the road to real intelligence.
people.bioZh: 强化学习之父，2024 年图灵奖得主，《苦涩的教训》作者。一位犀利的怀疑者——他认为当今的 LLM，是通往真正智能路上的一条死路。

Rich Sutton on the Alberta Plan and the Three Waves of Neural Networks

views.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
views.zh: 2024 年他强调：Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能扩展的算法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习。

views.en: AI should develop permissionless and decentralized; controlling AI goals is dangerous. The keys were never in our hand.
views.zh: 同年他主张 AI 应以无需许可、去中心化方式发展，试图控制 AI 目标很危险；钥匙从来不在我们手中。

views.en: RL is the basic AI paradigm; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal. LLMs lack world models and only mimic text.
views.zh: 2025 年他深化立场：强化学习才是基本 AI 范式，下一个词预测不是实质目标；大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿文本。

views.en: AGI needs a general architecture learning from runtime experience; design-time domain knowledge should be deprecated. Continual deep learning remains unsolved.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他提出 AGI 需要从运行时经验学习的通用架构，设计期领域知识应被弃用；可靠的持续深度学习仍未解决。

views.en: Continual learning is essential; LLMs stop learning after training. Synthetic data is a mistake; the field is weird, not me.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他更坚定：持续学习至关重要，LLM 训练后便停止学习；合成数据是错误方向，是领域奇怪而非我奇怪。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 总裁兼联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder and President of OpenAI and its longtime technical backbone. Former CTO of Stripe, and a central builder behind GPT and OpenAI's push toward self-improving AI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼总裁，长期的技术中坚。前 Stripe CTO;GPT 与 OpenAI “自我改进 AI” 路线背后的核心建造者。

views.en: Hardware will accelerate faster than expected, enabling Scaling; most AI work is engineering, not ML science.
views.zh: 2017 年，他判断 AI 硬件会以超预期速度变快，从而推动 Scaling（规模扩张）；AI 工作大多是工程而非机器学习科学，好的工程是进步关键。

views.en: AGI is the most transformative technology; deep learning's generality and scalability make it plausible, but Scaling alone won't yield reasoning.
views.zh: 2019 年，他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）将是最具变革性的技术，深度学习的通用性与可扩展性使其可信；但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不会产生推理，需要思维链等新想法。

views.en: Compute is the fundamental driver and biggest bottleneck; post-training with reinforcement learning refines base models into consistent behaviors.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他深化判断：算力是根本驱动力也是最大瓶颈；后训练结合强化学习把基础模型精炼成一致行为，语言模型可能已有世界模型。

views.en: Scaling laws continue unabated; compute access becomes a basic right, and the real bottleneck is compute supply, not architecture or data.
views.zh: 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律未见墙，算力获取将成为基本权利；真正瓶颈是算力供给，而非模型架构或数据。

views.en: AGI is a gradual process, not a destination; the future is a persistent, proactive personal AGI assistant with almost no interface.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步把 AGI 视为渐进过程而非终点；未来是持久、主动、几乎无界面的个人 AGI 助手，安全与治理须随能力同步扩展。

people.tiZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Mistral AI, Europe's leading open-weight model lab. A former DeepMind researcher and a prominent voice for open models and European AI sovereignty.
people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO——欧洲领先的开放权重模型实验室。前 DeepMind 研究员；开放模型与“欧洲 AI 主权”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: Small open models can match big ones; data quality beats raw compute, and open scrutiny makes AI safer.
views.zh: 2023 年，他强调小模型在推理上高效，数据质量比单纯堆算力更关键，开源通过广泛审视让 AI 更安全。

views.en: Scaling compute is not the only path; efficiency and data quality matter, and value accrues at the application layer.
views.zh: 2024 年，他深化立场：Scaling（规模扩张）算力并非唯一路径，效率与数据质量同等重要，价值将沉淀在应用层。

views.en: AI is an opportunity to embrace; sovereign AI needs control of data, infrastructure, and values, augmenting rather than replacing jobs.
views.zh: 2025 年，他转向主权 AI 叙事：AI 应被拥抱而非恐惧，主权 AI 需掌控数据、基础设施与价值观，AI 增强而非取代工作。

views.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical fine-tuning and agents, while pre-training hits a saturation wall.
views.zh: 2026 年初，他提出模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直微调与智能体，预训练正撞上饱和墙。

views.en: Europe has a two-year window for independent AI infrastructure; AGI is a direction, not a destination, and adoption is bottlenecked by organizations.
views.zh: 2026 年中，他警告欧洲只剩两年窗口建设独立 AI 基础设施；AGI 是方向而非终点，企业采用瓶颈在组织变革而非模型智能。

people.tiZh: xAI 创始人
people.bioEn: Founder of xAI (Grok) and CEO of Tesla and SpaceX. A central and polarizing force in AI through xAI, Tesla's self-driving, and the Optimus robot, and an outspoken voice on AI risk.
people.bioZh: xAI（Grok）创始人，特斯拉与 SpaceX CEO。通过 xAI、特斯拉自动驾驶与 Optimus 机器人，他是 AI 领域核心而又极具争议的力量，也常就 AI 风险高调发声。

views.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail, cutting cost per ton to orbit 100x; first principles drives breakthrough engineering.
views.zh: 2021年，他视完全快速可复用为火箭圣杯，能把每吨入轨成本降100倍；第一性原理是突破性工程的根基。

views.en: AI safety needs third-party referees and truth; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than large language models.
views.zh: 2023至24年，他主张AI安全需第三方裁判与坚持真相；并认为特斯拉真实世界AI比大语言模型更省算力。

views.en: Neuralink solves brain damage first, then enables human-AI symbiosis; human communication is under one bit per second.
views.zh: 2024至25年，他提出Neuralink先治脑损伤、再实现人机共生；并强调人类通信带宽不足每秒一比特。

views.en: We are at the start of an intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive this year or next, with 10-20% annihilation risk.
views.zh: 2025年，他称正处智能大爆炸起点，数字超级智能或今明两年到来，并给出10-20%的灭绝风险。

views.en: The singularity is now; AI will exceed all human intelligence by 2030, and space-based compute plus Optimus will drive abundance.
views.zh: 2026年，他认为奇点已至，AI将在2030年前超越全人类智能，太空算力与Optimus将带来丰裕时代。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: A co-author of "Attention Is All You Need" (the Transformer paper) and co-creator of TensorFlow's Tensor2Tensor. Now at OpenAI, working on reasoning models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 奠基论文《Attention Is All You Need》的共同作者，TensorFlow Tensor2Tensor 的共同创造者。现于 OpenAI 研究推理模型。

episodes.tEn: Is Reasoning Enough for Generalization?
Why AI Progress Isn't Slowing Down

views.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models with chain of thought and reinforcement learning yield more gains per compute; the slowdown narrative is wrong.
views.zh: 预训练缩放定律依然有效，但采用思维链和强化学习的推理模型能在单位算力上带来更多提升；AI放缓论是错误的。

views.en: Economic pressure to deploy smaller, cheaper models, plus distillation, shifted focus from scaling up; frontier models still fail at simple tasks.
views.zh: 部署更小、更便宜模型的经济压力，加上蒸馏技术，使焦点从规模扩张转移；前沿模型仍会在简单任务上失败。

views.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive recent gains, but generalization remains the key challenge; reasoning alone may not suffice.
views.zh: 后训练改进如强化学习和合成数据驱动了近期进展，但泛化仍是关键挑战；仅靠推理可能不够。

views.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns, unlike humans.
views.zh: 具备推理、强化学习和工具的Transformer能解决难题，但需要海量数据；模型只有在穷尽表面模式后才学会概念，与人类不同。

views.en: Coding agents boost productivity 5-10x; RL generalizes across domains but has jagged edges; near-term risks like system hacking matter more than existential risk.
views.zh: 编程智能体将生产力提升5-10倍；强化学习能跨领域泛化但有锯齿边缘；系统黑客等近期风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

people.tiZh: CMU 教授 · OpenAI 董事
people.bioEn: A Carnegie Mellon professor and head of its machine learning department, and a member of OpenAI's board. Known for work on adversarial robustness and deep learning theory.
people.bioZh: 卡内基梅隆大学教授、机器学习系主任，OpenAI 董事会成员。以对抗鲁棒性与深度学习理论的研究著称。

views.en: Early ML foundations: hypothesis classes, loss functions, optimization; evaluation via train/validation/test splits; neural nets lack optimality guarantees yet succeed.
views.zh: 2014 年机器学习讲座时期，他关注监督学习的假设类、损失函数与优化方法，强调用训练/验证/测试划分来评估以避免过拟合，并指出神经网络虽无最优参数保证却已取得重大成功。

views.en: Next-token prediction is a major scientific discovery; data shortage is a myth; architecture matters little; safety's core issue is specification-following.
views.zh: 到 2024 年，他认为下一个词预测能产生智能系统，是一项重大科学发现；数据短缺并非迫在眉睫，架构已不再关键，而 AI 安全当前最大的问题是模型无法可靠遵循规范。

views.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers, not just Scaling; bigger models are not automatically safer; jailbreaks transfer across models.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他的立场深化为：安全不能只靠 Scaling（规模扩张），需要显式训练与多层防御；更大的模型不会自动更安全，越狱字符串还能在模型间迁移。

views.en: AI has alien vulnerabilities; automated red teaming beats humans; capability does not correlate with robustness; the lethal trifecta drives prompt injection risk.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步提出，AI 具有异于传统软件的漏洞，自动化红队已能超越人类红队；模型能力与鲁棒性不相关，而提示注入的致命三要素构成核心风险。

views.en: Consistent thread: empirical scaling and data/compute drive capability, while architecture and raw data curation matter less than assumed.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：经验性的 Scaling（规模扩张）与数据/算力驱动能力提升，而架构与原始数据整理的重要性常被高估。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 研究员
people.bioEn: A researcher at Anthropic focused on scaling and reinforcement learning, and a prominent young voice on how far today's models can really go.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 研究员，专注于规模扩张与强化学习；关于「当前模型究竟能走多远」的代表性青年声音。
