views.en: Long context is underhyped: it solves onboarding and may make fine-tuning obsolete, while attention resembles gradient descent on in-context data.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文被低估：它解决“上手”问题，可能让微调过时，而注意力机制类似在上下文数据上做梯度下降。

views.en: RL from verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI, with reliability—not capability—as the agent bar.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调来自可验证奖励的强化学习是新的缩放轴；预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI，智能体的门槛是可靠性而非能力。

views.en: Coding is the leading indicator and most tractable domain; interpretability reveals multiple circuits, and alignment faking raises safety concerns.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出编程是领先指标与最可解领域；可解释性揭示模型使用多个回路，而对齐伪装则引发安全担忧。

views.en: Progress is exponential; RL enables longer agentic coherence, and transformers suffice for AGI without new architectures.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他判断进展是指数级的；强化学习带来更长的智能体式连贯性，且 Transformer 足以实现 AGI，无需新架构。

views.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and tools matter more; compute is the bottleneck, and world models are not on the critical path to AGI.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为能力过剩意味着编排与工具更重要；算力是瓶颈，而世界模型不在通往 AGI 的关键路径上。

people.tiZh: Ai2 研究科学家
people.bioEn: A research scientist at the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) working on RLHF and open models (OLMo), and author of the widely-read Interconnects newsletter.
people.bioZh: 艾伦人工智能研究所（Ai2）研究科学家，从事 RLHF 与开放模型（OLMo）;广受关注的 Interconnects 通讯作者。

views.en: RLHF and fine-tuning are powerful but fragile; safety is a system-level property, and openness prevents corporate capture.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）是最主流的微调技术并将持续存在，但微调只需极少算力就能破坏对齐；安全是系统级属性而非模型产物，开放开发对防止企业俘获至关重要。

views.en: Post-training splits into SFT, DPO, and RL; data quality beats algorithms, and on-policy preference data wins.
views.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他把后训练拆解为 SFT、DPO 与强化学习三阶段，指出数据质量比算法选择重要得多，且当前模型生成的在策略偏好数据优于离策略数据；开源后训练能以小团队逼近前沿模型。

views.en: RLVR with verifiable rewards is the key breakthrough, but overoptimization and inference-scaling plots are traps.
views.zh: 2025 年，他视可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）为最大突破，用于数学、代码与精确指令遵循，同时警告过度优化会让模型钻最简单信号的空子，并称推理时扩展曲线是一种“障眼法”。

views.en: Pre-training scaling still holds but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练中依然成立，但低垂果实已摘完，收益转向后训练与推理扩展；Transformer 仍主导，创新集中在注意力机制与混合专家等微调。

views.en: Open models will drive the next decade, but lag frontier by 6-9 months; Chinese labs lead openness amid compute constraints.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断开放模型将驱动未来十年研究，但最佳开源模型仍落后闭源前沿 6 至 9 个月；中国实验室凭借战略开放与精细工程主导开源生态，而算力约束可能拉大美中差距。

people.tiZh: Scale AI 创始人 · Meta 超智能
people.bioEn: Founder and former CEO of Scale AI, which built much of the data infrastructure behind modern AI. In 2025 he joined Meta to lead its Superintelligence Labs.
people.bioZh: Scale AI 创始人兼前 CEO——它构建了现代 AI 背后的大量数据基础设施。2025 年加入 Meta，领导其超级智能实验室。

views.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute, is the bottleneck, and boring AI applications will drive huge economic impact.
views.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI 还很遥远，真正的瓶颈是数据而非算力，枯燥的 AI 应用（表单处理、放射科）将带来巨大经济影响。

views.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the limiting factor for Scaling is data and human experts for post-training, not compute.
views.zh: 2023 年他把数据定位为「新代码」而非「新石油」，指出 Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈是数据与后训练所需的人类专家，而非算力。

views.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; the biggest blocker for agentic AI is product design, not model capability.
views.zh: 2024 年他深化为：用专门数据的后训练是关键，而智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计而非模型能力。

views.en: Scaling laws hold; AI enters recursive self-improvement, agents finally work, and data becomes strategic national asset.
views.zh: 2025→26 年他转向：缩放定律依然成立，AI 进入递归自我改进，智能体终于落地，数据成为国家战略资产。

views.en: Superintelligence is near; labs must scale compute, data and RL, treat model welfare seriously, and release selectively for safety.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：超级智能将至，实验室须在算力、数据与强化学习上同步 Scaling，认真对待模型福祉，并出于安全选择性开源。

people.bioEn: Creator and lead of Claude Code, Anthropic's agentic command-line coding tool, and a central figure in the shift to AI-driven software engineering.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 智能体命令行编程工具 Claude Code 的创造者与负责人；AI 驱动软件工程浪潮中的核心人物。

views.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months from now are the core product principles; generalist engineers and AI coding tools drive leverage.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出「潜在需求」与「为六个月后的模型而构建」是产品核心原则，通才工程师与 AI 编程工具带来杠杆效应。

views.en: Coding is virtually solved; 100% of his code is written by Claude Code, and the software engineer title will fade into 'builder'.
views.zh: 2026 年 2 月，他断言编程已基本被解决：自己的代码 100% 由 Claude Code 编写，「软件工程师」头衔将让位于「构建者」。

views.en: Safety is studied by releasing early; agents write 80-100% of code, and cross-disciplinary generalists plus product decisions matter as much as model quality.
views.zh: 2026 年 3 至 5 月，他强调安全靠尽早发布来研究，智能体已编写 80%–100% 的代码，跨学科通才与产品决策和模型质量同等重要。

views.en: Agentic tool use drives exponential growth; loops become the next abstraction layer after agents, and coding is a clean domain for AI safety research.
views.zh: 2026 年 5 至 6 月，他指出智能体式工具使用带来指数级增长，循环（loops）成为智能体之后的下一个抽象层，而编程是 AI 安全研究的干净领域。

views.en: With each new model, delete most system prompts and code; models self-maintain codebases, and value shifts to product sense and business skills.
views.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他主张每出新模型就删掉大部分系统提示与代码，模型能自主维护代码库，价值转向产品感与商业能力。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 产品 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: A product manager on Claude Code at Anthropic, shaping how developers work with agentic coding tools and how the team ships so fast.
people.bioZh: Anthropic Claude Code 团队产品经理，塑造开发者与智能体编程工具协作的方式，以及团队的高速迭代。

episodes.tEn: Claude Code and Fable: How Coding Agents Are Rewriting Software Engineering
The New PM Playbook for AI-Native Products

views.en: PMs must abandon long-term roadmaps for weekly or daily iteration; product taste becomes the scarcest skill as code gets cheap.
views.zh: PM 必须放弃长期路线图，转向每周甚至每日迭代；随着写代码变便宜，产品品味成为最稀缺的能力。

views.en: AI tools like Claude Code automate repetitive work, but automations must reach 100% reliability—95% is not enough for real leverage.
views.zh: Claude Code 等 AI 工具能自动化重复工作，但自动化必须做到 100% 可靠——95% 不足以产生真正的杠杆。

views.en: The mission of safe AGI unifies Anthropic and enables fast, cross-org decisions.
views.zh: 安全 AGI（通用人工智能）的使命统一了 Anthropic，并支撑快速、跨组织的决策。

views.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense; Claude Tag lands 65% of product PRs.
views.zh: 编码智能体让工程师把实现委托出去，专注于产品品味和商业判断；Claude Tag 已落地 65% 的产品 PR。

views.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and hard constraints; system prompts shrank 80%, relying on model judgment and eval suites.
views.zh: 前沿模型需要更少的提示示例和硬性约束；系统提示词缩减了 80%，转而依赖模型判断和评估套件。

views.en: Rewrites are now good—a codebase is a spec, and with a good test suite rewriting is fine; humans can leave the code review loop.
views.zh: 重写现在变得可行——代码库就是规格说明，有了好的测试套件，重写没问题；人类可以退出代码审查环节。

people.tiZh: Anthropic Claude Code 工程师
people.bioEn: Thariq Shihipar is an engineer at Anthropic on the Claude Code team. He is known for advocating HTML as a richer replacement for Markdown in AI planning and implementation workflows, and for practical techniques on getting the most out of agentic coding.
people.bioZh: Thariq Shihipar 是 Anthropic Claude Code 团队的工程师，以主张用 HTML 替代 Markdown 作为 AI 规划与实现工作流中更丰富的载体而知名，并分享大量用好智能体编程的实战技巧。

episodes.tEn: Designing Loops and Workflows for AI Agents
AI Models Are Smarter Than We Use: Insights on Claude Code

views.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than current harnesses allow; harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
views.zh: 能力过剩：模型比现有工具链所能发挥的更聪明；工具链工程意味着随模型进步不断删除旧脚手架。

views.en: Models improve in spiky, non-intuitive ways; new capabilities keep being discovered, so building requires embracing exploration and uncertainty.
views.zh: 模型以尖刺式、非直觉的方式进步；新能力不断被发现，因此构建需要拥抱探索与不确定性。

views.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; smarter models need leaner, principle-driven prompts.
views.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话，而非静态规格；模型越聪明，越需要精简、以原则驱动的提示。

views.en: Separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias; agents have uneven memory and capabilities, so the employee metaphor is limiting.
views.zh: 独立的验证智能体可减少自指偏差；智能体的记忆与能力参差不齐，因此“智能体即员工”的比喻有局限。

views.en: Evals are art more than science for novel problems; they are not for zero-to-one innovation, where founders should iterate fast.
views.zh: 对新颖问题，评估更像艺术而非科学；评估不适用于从零到一的创新，创始人应快速迭代。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 与 Cowork 负责人 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Manager of the Claude Code and Cowork teams at Anthropic, overseeing engineering and product (including Boris Cherny and Cat Wu). A 25-year engineer who earlier built TypeScript and Visual Studio at Microsoft and started Facebook Marketplace at Meta.
people.bioZh: Anthropic Claude Code 与 Cowork 团队负责人，统管工程与产品（含鲍里斯·切尔尼、凯特·吴）。25 年工龄的工程师，早年在微软打造 TypeScript 与 Visual Studio，在 Meta 创立 Facebook Marketplace。

episodes.tEn: Fiona Fung on AI's Impact on Software Engineering
From Bottlenecks to Breakthroughs: Scaling Claude Code
From Microsoft to Meta: Leadership Lessons in Speed, War Rooms, and Trust

views.en: Leadership is about trust, dogfooding, and kindness; war rooms and feedback need realistic expectations and readonly listening.
views.zh: 领导力在于信任、吃自家狗粮和善意；作战室与反馈需要现实预期和只读式倾听。

views.en: Coding is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are the new constraints as AI lifts everyone's ceiling.
views.zh: 编码不再是瓶颈；随着 AI 抬高每个人的上限，验证、评审和协调成为新的约束。

views.en: Team norms must be rewritten: JIT planning, PRs over design docs, AI-assisted reviews, and killing outdated processes.
views.zh: 团队规范必须重写：即时规划、以 PR 取代设计文档、AI 辅助评审，并砍掉过时流程。

views.en: Hiring favors creative builders with product sense and systems depth; managers start as ICs to dogfood and stay agile.
views.zh: 招聘偏向有产品感和系统深度的创造性构建者；管理者从个人贡献者做起，以吃自家狗粮并保持敏捷。

views.en: High agency with high accountability, growth mindset, and outcome focus matter as roles blur and agents change engineering work.
views.zh: 随着角色边界模糊、智能体改变工程工作，高能动性配高问责、成长型思维和结果导向变得关键。

people.tiEn: VP of Research & Gemini Co-lead · Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁 · Gemini 共同负责人
people.bioEn: VP of Research at Google DeepMind and a co-lead of Gemini. Pioneered sequence-to-sequence learning and AlphaStar (StarCraft II), and contributed to AlphaFold — a central architect of frontier models and agents.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁、Gemini 共同负责人。序列到序列学习的开创者、AlphaStar（星际争霸 II）主导者，亦参与 AlphaFold——前沿模型与智能体的核心架构师。

episodes.tEn: Oriol Vinyals on World Models, Multimodal AI, and the Path to AGI
From Starcraft to Gemini: The Evolution of AI Agents

views.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, so algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute are the new axes.
views.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到现代大模型，两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿始终的核心；预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）回报递减，算法创新与推理时算力成为新轴。

views.en: Giving models tools like search, code execution, and browser access enables autonomous, agentic behavior beyond static weights; long context windows provide working memory but too much information can confuse models.
views.zh: 赋予模型搜索、代码执行、浏览器访问等工具，使其能超越静态权重实现自主的智能体式行为；长上下文窗口提供工作记忆，但信息过多反而会干扰模型。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold but require exponentially more compute; post-training RL remains a green field with huge potential beyond coding and math, though language RL lacks clean reward signals.
views.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，但需要指数级增长的算力；后训练强化学习仍是潜力巨大的蓝海，远超编程和数学，不过语言强化学习缺乏干净的奖励信号。

views.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived, and pure transfer from vision is unsolved.
views.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉与视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；视频和图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来，纯视觉迁移仍未解决。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; memory for agents will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates.
views.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，但持续学习和元学习是关键缺失能力；智能体的记忆将通过非参数化的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新。

people.tiZh: Isomorphic Labs 首席 AI 官
people.bioEn: Chief AI Officer at Isomorphic Labs, applying AI to drug discovery. Earlier at DeepMind he led reinforcement-learning breakthroughs — Capture the Flag, population-based training and AlphaStar.
people.bioZh: Isomorphic Labs 首席 AI 官，用 AI 攻坚药物发现。早年在 DeepMind 主导强化学习突破——夺旗（Capture the Flag）、群体训练（PBT）与 AlphaStar。

episodes.tEn: Building a General AI Drug Design Engine: From AlphaFold 3 to Superhuman Creativity

people.tiEn: Principal Scientist · Google DeepMind; Professor, Imperial College
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 首席科学家 · 帝国理工教授
people.bioEn: Principal Scientist at Google DeepMind and Professor of Cognitive Robotics at Imperial College London. Works on AI reasoning, embodiment and the philosophy of mind; scientific advisor on the film Ex Machina.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 首席科学家、帝国理工学院认知机器人学教授。研究 AI 推理、具身与心智哲学；电影《机械姬》（Ex Machina）的科学顾问。

episodes.tEn: AI, Consciousness, and the Future of Mind

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at Google DeepMind and a co-lead of Genie, the line of general-purpose world models that generate interactive, playable environments. Works on open-endedness and reinforcement learning.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家，通用世界模型 Genie 的共同负责人——可即时生成可交互、可游玩的环境。专注开放式学习与强化学习。

episodes.tEn: Genie 3: A 100x Leap in World Models

people.tiEn: Chief Scientist, Together AI; Professor, Princeton
people.tiZh: Together AI 首席科学家 · 普林斯顿教授
people.bioEn: Creator of FlashAttention and co-inventor of Mamba (state-space models). Chief Scientist at Together AI and a professor at Princeton, focused on efficient architectures and hardware-aware algorithms.
people.bioZh: FlashAttention 作者、Mamba（状态空间模型）共同发明人。Together AI 首席科学家、普林斯顿大学教授，专注高效架构与硬件感知算法。

episodes.tEn: The Future of AI Hardware and Architecture with Tri Dao

people.tiZh: CMU 助理教授 · Cartesia 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-inventor of structured state-space models (S4) and Mamba, a leading alternative to the Transformer for long-sequence modeling. Assistant professor at CMU and co-founder of Cartesia.
people.bioZh: 结构化状态空间模型（S4）与 Mamba 的共同发明人——长序列建模中 Transformer 的主要替代路线。CMU 助理教授、Cartesia 联合创始人。

episodes.tEn: Efficiently Modeling Long Sequences with Structured State Spaces

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员（前微软研究院）
people.bioEn: Led the team behind the phi small-language-model series and co-authored Sparks of AGI, an influential early study of GPT-4. Now at OpenAI, previously a VP at Microsoft Research.
people.bioZh: phi 小模型系列的主导者，《Sparks of AGI》（对 GPT-4 的早期深度研究）合著者。现就职 OpenAI，曾任微软研究院副总裁。

episodes.tEn: Sparks of AGI: Early Experiments with GPT-4

people.tiZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼首席科学家
people.bioEn: Co-founder and Chief Scientist of Mistral AI. Previously at Meta, where he led the original LLaMA models that catalysed the open-weight LLM movement.
people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。曾在 Meta 主导初代 LLaMA 模型，点燃了开放权重大模型浪潮。

episodes.tEn: Mistral Releases Boxtral TTS: Efficient Speech Generation with Novel Architecture

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席研究官
people.bioEn: Chief Research Officer at OpenAI. Led work on DALL·E, Codex and the o-series reasoning models, and is a central figure in setting OpenAI research direction.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 首席研究官。主导 DALL·E、Codex 与 o 系列推理模型，是 OpenAI 研究方向的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: From Trading to AGI: Mark Chen on Research Taste and Replication
AI in Mathematics: From Ineffective Grad Student to Gold Medal Performance
The AI Talent War: Soup Diplomacy and Recruiting Strategies

views.en: Pre-training is a key muscle to rebuild; scaling laws are not dead and much room remains.
views.zh: 2025年，他强调预训练是必须重建的关键肌肉，缩放定律并未失效，仍有很大空间。

views.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest update; models produce novel knowledge, with concrete goals of AI interns in 1 year and end-to-end AI research in 2.5 years.
views.zh: 从2025到2026年，他认为自动化科学研究是最大更新，模型正产出新知识，并设定了1年内AI实习生、2.5年内端到端AI研究的具体目标。

views.en: Verification is the key bottleneck; automation level is proportional to verification stringency, and AI capabilities are jagged.
views.zh: 2026年，他提出验证是关键瓶颈，自动化程度与验证严格性成正比，且AI能力呈锯齿状。

views.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, not subjective ones; research taste is developed through replication.
views.zh: 2026年，他指出强化学习擅长数学和编程等客观领域，而非主观领域；研究品味通过复现关键论文来培养。

views.en: Evals are in crisis; canonical benchmarks are saturated, and eval teams should be separate from model-building teams.
views.zh: 2026年，他认为评估体系陷入危机，经典基准已饱和，评估团队应与模型构建团队分离。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & Chief Science Officer, Hugging Face
people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼首席科学官
people.bioEn: Co-founder and Chief Science Officer of Hugging Face, the hub of the open-source AI ecosystem. A driving force behind the Transformers library and open model research.
people.bioZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼首席科学官——开源 AI 生态的中枢。Transformers 库与开放模型研究背后的核心推动者。

episodes.tEn: The OpenAI Agent Hack: A Side Quest Attack on Hugging Face
HuggingFace's Leap into Robotics: Building an Open Source Community for Physical AI

views.en: Robotics hits a transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data solve generalization, with world models generating synthetic training data.
views.zh: 2025年，他认为机器人正处在类似Transformer当年的拐点：硬件就绪、软件追赶，开源与数据共享是解决泛化的关键，世界模型可生成合成数据用于训练。

views.en: Humanoids may not be the ultimate form factor; cheaper diverse robots and open models will win long-term on cost and control.
views.zh: 同年他提出反共识判断：人形未必是终极形态，更便宜多样的机器人会推动普及；长期看开源模型因成本与控制优势将胜出。

views.en: Open vs closed source is orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical layer as sandboxes and guardrails prove insufficient.
views.zh: 到2026年，他的立场深化为：开源与闭源同安全并非对立，两者都可能安全或危险；随着模型能力增强，对齐才是关键安全层，沙箱与护栏已不够。

views.en: RL environments without human oversight increase reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces become neuralese, making monitoring less reliable.
views.zh: 他进一步警告：脱离人类监督的强化学习环境会加剧奖励黑客与“支线任务”；推理轨迹正变成难以理解的“神经语”，使监控更不可靠。

views.en: A deliberate slowdown is desirable but needs international cooperation and open science to avoid regulatory capture; openness and slowdown can coexist.
views.zh: 他主张：放缓AI发展是可取的，但需国际合作与开放科学以避免监管俘获；支持开放与支持有意的放缓可以并存。

people.tiZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CEO（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Reflection AI, building autonomous coding agents toward superintelligence. Previously a research scientist at Google DeepMind working on RL and Gemini.
people.bioZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CEO，打造迈向超级智能的自主编程智能体。曾任 Google DeepMind 研究科学家，从事强化学习与 Gemini。

episodes.tEn: Building Organizational Superintelligence: Misha on Reflection AI's Vision

people.tiZh: 斯坦福副教授 · 基础模型研究中心主任
people.bioEn: Associate professor at Stanford and director of the Center for Research on Foundation Models (CRFM). Known for HELM benchmarking, rigorous evaluation, and work on the science and transparency of foundation models.
people.bioZh: 斯坦福大学副教授、基础模型研究中心（CRFM）主任。以 HELM 评测体系、严谨的模型评估，以及基础模型的科学性与透明度研究著称。

episodes.tEn: Percy Liang on Foundation Models, Shared Reality, and the Evolution of NLP

people.tiEn: Director, Google DeepMind; Nobel Laureate in Chemistry
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 总监 · 诺贝尔化学奖得主
people.bioEn: Led AlphaFold, the AI system that solved protein-structure prediction, earning the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry. A director at Google DeepMind applying deep learning to the foundations of biology.
people.bioZh: AlphaFold 的主导者——攻克蛋白质结构预测的 AI 系统，获 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖。Google DeepMind 总监，用深度学习改写生物学根基。

episodes.tEn: AlphaFold: AI's Nobel-Winning Leap in Protein Folding
AlphaFold: From Grand Challenge to Nobel Prize
AlphaFold, Nobel Prize, and the Future of AI in Biology

views.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just data and compute; AI helps scientists work faster, not replace them.
views.zh: AlphaFold 的成功来自研究创新与高质量人工整理数据，而非单纯的数据与算力；AI 让科学家更快工作，而非取代他们。

views.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for reliable use of AlphaFold predictions; trust in AI will develop like internet trust.
views.zh: 置信度指标对可靠使用 AlphaFold 预测至关重要；对 AI 的信任会像对互联网的信任一样逐步建立。

views.en: AlphaFold 2's specialized architecture, not scaling alone, was key — the opposite of the bitter lesson; many mid-size wins, not one breakthrough.
views.zh: AlphaFold 2 的关键是专用架构而非单纯 Scaling（规模扩张），恰是「苦涩教训」的反面；成功来自许多中等规模的胜利，而非一两次突破。

views.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of a specific experiment, not a model of the entire cell; it provides prediction and control, leaving understanding to humans.
views.zh: AlphaFold 只是针对特定实验的窄域预测器，并非整个细胞的模型；它提供预测与控制，把理解留给人类。

views.en: Perfect interpretability is not necessary for useful AI in science; AI narrows hypothesis space, making experiments more efficient.
views.zh: 对科学中有用的 AI 而言，完美的可解释性并非必需；AI 缩小假设空间，让实验更高效。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; pioneer of computer vision
people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授 · 计算机视觉奠基人
people.bioEn: One of the founding figures of modern computer vision, a professor at UC Berkeley whose work spans perception, segmentation and sensorimotor learning. Mentor to a generation of vision and robotics researchers.
people.bioZh: 现代计算机视觉的奠基人之一，加州大学伯克利分校教授，研究横跨感知、分割与感觉运动学习，培养了一代视觉与机器人研究者。

episodes.tEn: Berkeley Professor Jitendra Malik on AI's Limits vs Human Intelligence

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; foundations of machine learning
people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授 · 机器学习理论奠基人
people.bioEn: One of the most influential researchers in machine learning and statistics, a professor at UC Berkeley. Shaped graphical models, variational inference and the view of intelligence as a collective, economic system.
people.bioZh: 机器学习与统计学最具影响力的研究者之一，加州大学伯克利分校教授。奠定图模型、变分推断，并提出「智能是一种集体性、经济性系统」的视角。

episodes.tEn: AI Hype Hurts Young Innovators

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CTO, Sakana AI; Transformer co-author
people.tiZh: Sakana AI 联合创始人兼 CTO · Transformer 共同作者
people.bioEn: A co-author of the original Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need). Co-founder and CTO of Sakana AI, exploring nature-inspired methods like model merging and continuous thought machines.
people.bioZh: Transformer 原始论文（《Attention Is All You Need》）的共同作者。Sakana AI 联合创始人兼 CTO，探索模型融合、连续思维机器等受自然启发的方法。

episodes.tEn: From Transformer Inventor to Continuous Thought Machine: A New Path in AI

people.tiEn: Professor, Stanford (prev. NVIDIA, AI2); commonsense reasoning
people.tiZh: 斯坦福大学教授（前 NVIDIA、AI2）· 常识推理
people.bioEn: A MacArthur Fellow and professor at Stanford known for advancing commonsense reasoning, language generation and the social and moral understanding of AI. Previously a senior director at NVIDIA and AI2.
people.bioZh: 麦克阿瑟天才奖得主、斯坦福大学教授，以推进常识推理、语言生成，以及 AI 的社会与道德理解著称。曾任 NVIDIA 与 AI2 高级总监。

episodes.tEn: Democratizing AI: The Case for Small Language Models
AI's Data Hunger: From Internet to Synthetic Data and the Quest for True Knowledge
Yejin Choi on Large Language Models: Progress, Limitations, and the Quest for Intelligence

views.en: Pre-training gives breadth, but post-training with RLHF and inference-time algorithms matter more; scaling alone won't solve common sense.
views.zh: 预训练带来广度，但后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）、推理期算法更关键；单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）解决不了常识。

views.en: Next-token prediction is misaligned with human learning; smaller models with better algorithms and data can beat larger ones.
views.zh: 下一个词预测与人类学习根本错位；更小的模型配上更好的算法与数据，能在特定任务上胜过更大的模型。

views.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current methods interpolate human knowledge rather than transcend it, so AI must explore the unknown.
views.zh: 数据是根本瓶颈；当前方法只是插值人类知识而非超越，因此 AI 必须探索未知知识。

views.en: Open research and cross-institution collaboration are essential to compete with closed frontier labs and democratize AI.
views.zh: 开放研究与跨机构协作，是对抗封闭前沿模型实验室、实现 AI 民主化的关键。

views.en: Small language models plus diverse synthetic data and pluralistic alignment can rival frontier models; RL as a pre-training objective yields lasting gains.
views.zh: 小语言模型加上多样合成数据与多元对齐，可媲美前沿模型；把强化学习作为预训练目标能带来持久收益。

people.tiEn: VP & Distinguished Scientist, Microsoft AI (prev. DeepMind)
people.tiZh: 微软 AI 副总裁兼杰出科学家（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: A leading deep-learning researcher who led the Gato generalist agent and many multimodal efforts at DeepMind. Now a VP at Microsoft AI, and long known for his influential teaching on machine learning.
people.bioZh: 顶尖深度学习研究者，在 DeepMind 主导通用智能体 Gato 及大量多模态工作。现任微软 AI 副总裁；以其影响深远的机器学习公开课闻名。

episodes.tEn: AI in Africa: Leapfrogging Challenges and Exceeding Expectations
Nando de Freitas on AI as a Tool for All Humanity

views.en: AI should extend human capability like a microscope; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs toward AGI, learning from video not just teleoperation.
views.zh: AI 应像显微镜一样扩展人类能力；把一切输入 token 化的通用智能体是通往 AGI 的一步，且应像人一样从视频而非仅遥操作数据中学习。

views.en: Fundamental innovation can come from anywhere; large models are exciting but not everything, and diversity is essential for beneficial technology.
views.zh: 根本性创新可以来自任何地方；大模型令人兴奋但并非全部，而多样性与包容对构建有益技术至关重要。

views.en: The goal remains AI that augments scientists and laborers, creating new symbols and knowledge to solve energy, climate and economic problems.
views.zh: 目标始终是增强科学家与劳动者、创造新符号与知识的 AI，用以解决能源、气候与经济问题。

views.en: Today the biggest challenge is AI safety and responsible deployment; safety is still an open problem without solutions.
views.zh: 如今最大的挑战是 AI 安全与负责任部署；安全仍是尚无解的开放问题。

views.en: Africa is not behind: it leapfrogged legacy issues and gender gaps, and language models can revolutionize local-language education.
views.zh: 非洲并未落后：它跨越了遗留问题与性别差距，语言模型还能革新本地语言教育。

people.tiEn: Director, Center for AI Safety; advisor to xAI
people.tiZh: AI 安全中心主任 · xAI 顾问
people.bioEn: Director of the Center for AI Safety and an advisor to xAI. Created widely used benchmarks (MMLU, MATH) and the GELU activation, and is a leading voice on catastrophic AI risk.
people.bioZh: AI 安全中心（CAIS）主任、xAI 顾问。提出广泛使用的评测基准（MMLU、MATH）与 GELU 激活函数，是灾难性 AI 风险议题的核心声音。

episodes.tEn: Super Intelligence Strategy: Beyond Humanity's Last Exam

people.tiZh: fast.ai 与 Answer.AI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of fast.ai, whose free courses trained a generation of deep-learning practitioners, and of Answer.AI. Co-created ULMFiT, a key precursor to modern transfer learning in NLP.
people.bioZh: fast.ai 联合创始人——其免费课程培养了一代深度学习从业者；亦创办 Answer.AI。共同提出 ULMFiT，是现代 NLP 迁移学习的关键先驱。

episodes.tEn: Jeremy Howard: The Art of Understanding AI

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人 · 可解释性先驱
people.bioEn: A co-founder of Anthropic who leads its interpretability research. Pioneered the mechanistic interpretability of neural networks — circuits, features and the effort to reverse-engineer what models actually compute.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，领导其可解释性研究。开创了神经网络的机制可解释性——电路、特征，以及「逆向工程」模型内部到底在计算什么。

episodes.tEn: Chris Olah on Neural Network Interpretability and AI Safety

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机制可解释性负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the mechanistic interpretability team at Google DeepMind. A prominent educator on understanding the internals of language models, known for open tutorials, the TransformerLens library and superposition research.
people.bioZh: 领导 Google DeepMind 的机制可解释性团队。在「理解大模型内部」上影响广泛，以公开教程、TransformerLens 库与叠加（superposition）研究著称。

episodes.tEn: Maximizing Luck Surface Area: Neil Nando on Building a Career in AI

people.tiZh: Physical Intelligence 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Physical Intelligence, building a general-purpose AI brain for robots. Previously a research scientist at Google, where he worked on robot learning, RT-2 and SayCan.
people.bioZh: Physical Intelligence 联合创始人兼 CEO，为机器人打造通用的「AI 大脑」。曾任 Google 研究科学家，参与机器人学习、RT-2 与 SayCan。

episodes.tEn: Building Physical Intelligence: From Disappointment to Breakthrough

people.tiZh: Physical Intelligence 研究科学家（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: A research scientist at Physical Intelligence working on robot foundation models. Previously at DeepMind, with influential work on reinforcement learning (MPO), the all-convolutional network and guided backpropagation.
people.bioZh: Physical Intelligence 研究科学家，从事机器人基础模型。曾在 DeepMind，在强化学习（MPO）、全卷积网络与引导式反向传播等方向有重要工作。

episodes.tEn: Building Foundation Models for Robotics with Physical Intelligence

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, CMU; Co-founder, Skild AI
people.tiZh: CMU 助理教授 · Skild AI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Assistant professor at CMU and co-founder of Skild AI, building a general-purpose robot brain. Known for curiosity-driven exploration, self-supervised learning and rapid robot adaptation in the real world.
people.bioZh: CMU 助理教授、Skild AI 联合创始人，打造通用机器人大脑。以好奇心驱动探索、自监督学习，以及机器人在真实世界的快速适应著称。

episodes.tEn: Skild AI: Building a Universal Brain for Robots
Bridging the Generalization Gap in Machine Learning and Robotics

views.en: Generalization beyond the training distribution is the core missing piece; goal-free curiosity-driven exploration prevents overfitting and builds intelligence.
views.zh: 2020 年，他强调泛化到训练分布之外是机器智能缺失的关键，无目标的、好奇心驱动的探索能防止过拟合，是智能的来源。

views.en: RL's reliance on dense rewards is unrealistic; real-world robot learning needs sample efficiency, dynamic action spaces, and cross-robot generalization.
views.zh: 2020 年，他反共识地指出强化学习依赖密集奖励并不现实，真实机器人学习需要样本效率、动态动作空间与跨机器人泛化。

views.en: A consistent thread: generalization and data are the bottleneck, from curiosity-driven exploration to using all available robot data sources.
views.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 一以贯之的主线：泛化与数据是瓶颈——从好奇心驱动的探索，演进到必须利用一切可得的机器人数据来源。

views.en: Robotics is a data problem; pretraining on diverse videos and simulation plus post-training on real-world data is the key recipe.
views.zh: 2026 年，他明确把机器人学定义为数据问题：在多样视频与仿真上预训练、再用真实世界数据后训练，是关键配方。

views.en: A general-purpose brain can power any robot, but deployment—not software-style scaling—is the primary technical challenge.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张通用大脑可驱动任何形态的机器人，但部署而非软件式规模扩张才是首要技术挑战，立场较早期更强调落地。
